- `stock` represents available stock
- `reservedStock` represents stock reserved by pending orders
- Effective stock = `stock` - `reservedStock`
- `priceAdjustment` modifies the product's `basePrice` for this variant

## DATA FLOW ANALYSIS

### Customer Registration Flow

```
User submits registration form
  → auth.ts handler validates input
  → Supabase Auth creates auth user
  → profiles table: INSERT (role=customer, emailVerified=false)
  → auth_sessions table: INSERT (accessToken, refreshToken)
  → verification_attempts table: INSERT (code, email)
  → notifications table: INSERT (type=welcome, channel=in_app)
  → Audit: user_action_logs INSERT
```

### Authentication Flow

```
User submits login credentials
  → login_attempts table: INSERT (email, ipAddress, success)
  → profiles table: SELECT (email lookup)
  → Supabase Auth verifies password
  → profiles table: UPDATE (lastLoginAt, loginCount++)
  → auth_sessions table: INSERT (new session)
  → Audit: user_action_logs INSERT
```

### Session Rotation Flow

```
Refresh token received
  → auth_sessions table: SELECT (find old session)
  → Transaction:
    → auth_sessions table: INSERT (new session, rotatedFromSessionId)
    → auth_sessions table: UPDATE (old session: isActive=false, revokedAt)
  → Return new token pair
```

### Product Browsing Flow

```
Customer browses products
  → categories table: SELECT (active categories)
  → products table: SELECT (filtered by category, gender, etc.)
  → product_variants table: JOIN (available variants)
  → product_images table: JOIN (primary images)
  → brands table: JOIN (brand info)
  → GIN trigram search available via $queryRaw
```

### Add to Cart Flow

```
Customer adds variant to cart
  → carts table: SELECT or INSERT (get/create cart)
  → Transaction:
    → cart_items table: SELECT (check existing)
    → cart_items table: INSERT or UPDATE (quantity)
    → carts table: UPDATE (updatedAt timestamp)
```

### Checkout Flow

```
Customer initiates checkout
  → carts table: SELECT (cart items with variants)
  → Transaction (critical):
    → product_variants table: UPDATE (stock--, reservedStock++)
    → orders table: INSERT (order header)
    → order_items table: INSERT (line items)
    → order_status_history table: INSERT (status=pending)
    → carts table: DELETE (clear cart)
  → Razorpay: create order
  → Return order + razorpayOrderId
```

### Payment Capture Flow

```
Razorpay webhook: payment.captured
  → webhook_events table: SELECT (idempotency check)
  → Transaction:
    → webhook_events table: INSERT (event log)
    → orders table: UPDATE (paymentStatus=paid, razorpayPaymentId)
    → order_status_history table: INSERT (status=confirmed)
    → notifications table: INSERT (type=payment_success)
  → Idempotent: skip if already processed
```

### Payment Failure Flow

```
Razorpay webhook: payment.failed
  → Transaction:
    → orders table: UPDATE (paymentStatus=failed)
    → product_variants table: UPDATE (stock++, reservedStock--) [release stock]
    → inventory_movements table: INSERT (restore stock record)
    → order_status_history table: INSERT
    → notifications table: INSERT (type=payment_failed)
```

### Order Cancellation Flow

```
Customer or admin cancels order
  → orders table: SELECT (verify cancellable status)
  → Transaction:
    → orders table: UPDATE (status=cancelled, cancelledAt)
    → product_variants table: UPDATE (stock++, reservedStock--) [batch]
    → inventory_movements table: INSERT (per variant)
    → order_status_history table: INSERT
    → notifications table: INSERT (type=order_cancelled)
```

### Return Request Flow

```
Customer requests return
  → orders table: SELECT (verify delivered)
  → return_requests table: INSERT (reason, evidence)
  → notifications table: INSERT (type=return_requested)

Admin approves return
  → Transaction:
    → return_requests table: UPDATE (status=approved)
    → refunds table: INSERT (amount, status=pending)
    → orders table: UPDATE (status=returned)
    → product_variants table: UPDATE (stock++)
    → inventory_movements table: INSERT
    → notifications table: INSERT (type=return_approved)
```

### Refund Processing Flow

```
Admin processes refund
  → Transaction:
    → refunds table: UPDATE (status=completed, processedAt)
    → orders table: UPDATE (paymentStatus, refundedAt)
    → notifications table: INSERT (type=refund_processed)
```

### Coupon Redemption Flow

```
Customer applies coupon at checkout
  → coupons table: SELECT (validate code, dates, limits)
  → coupon_redemptions table: SELECT (check per-user limit)
  → orders table: INSERT (with discount applied)
  → coupon_redemptions table: INSERT (orderId, profileId, couponId)
  → coupons table: UPDATE (usedCount++)
```

### Wishlist Flow

```
Customer adds to wishlist
  → wishlist_items table: INSERT (profileId, variantId)
  → Unique constraint prevents duplicates

Customer removes from wishlist
  → wishlist_items table: DELETE
```

### Review Flow

```
Customer submits review
  → reviews table: SELECT (check unique constraint)
  → reviews table: INSERT (productId, profileId, orderId, rating, body)
  → Unique constraint: (productId, profileId, orderId)

Admin approves review
  → reviews table: UPDATE (isApproved=true)
```

### Search Flow

```
Customer searches products
  → search_history table: INSERT (profileId, query)
  → trending_searches table: UPDATE (searchCount++)
  → products table: $queryRaw (pg_trgm similarity search)
  → categories table: $queryRaw (pg_trgm similarity search)
  → brands table: $queryRaw (pg_trgm similarity search)
```

### Media Upload Flow

```
Admin uploads media
  → Cloudinary: upload file
  → media_assets table: INSERT (url, publicId, entityType, entityId)
  → media_audit_logs table: INSERT (action=upload)
  → usage_cache update
```

### Media Delete Flow

```
Admin deletes media (soft)
  → media_assets table: UPDATE (deletedAt, deletedBy)
  → media_audit_logs table: INSERT (action=delete)
  → Cloudinary: NOT deleted (soft delete)

Admin permanently deletes media
  → Transaction:
    → Cloudinary: DELETE asset
    → media_assets table: DELETE
    → media_audit_logs table: INSERT (action=permanent_delete)
    → usage_cache invalidation
```

### Background Job Flow

```
Job enqueued
  → job_queue table: INSERT (jobType, payload, priority)

Job processor picks up
  → job_queue table: UPDATE (status=processing, startedAt)
  → Execute job logic
  → On success:
    → job_queue table: UPDATE (status=completed, completedAt)
  → On failure:
    → job_queue table: UPDATE (retryCount++, status=retrying)
    → If maxRetries exceeded:
      → job_queue table: UPDATE (status=failed)
      → dead_letter_queue table: INSERT (job details)
```

### CMS Content Flow

```
Admin manages homepage sections
  → homepage_sections table: SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE
  → Transaction for reordering:
    → homepage_sections table: UPDATE (sortOrder) per section
  → Visibility: all, logged_in, logged_out
  → Scheduling: publishAt, expireAt
```

### Transaction Inventory (29 Total Usages)

| # | Location | Type | Purpose | Isolation |
|---|----------|------|---------|-----------|
| 1 | auth.ts:872 | Array | Session rotation (create + revoke) | Default |
| 2 | auth.ts:1331 | Interactive | Password reset token consumption | Default |
| 3 | checkout.ts:531 | Interactive | Order creation (stock + order + items) | Default |
| 4 | payments.ts:128 | Interactive | Payment capture (idempotent) | Default |
| 5 | payments.ts:259 | Interactive | Payment failure (release stock) | Default |
| 6 | payments.ts:389 | Interactive | Refund processing | Default |
| 7 | payments.ts:528 | Interactive | Webhook payment succeeded | Default |
| 8 | payments.ts:603 | Interactive | Webhook payment failed | Default |
| 9 | payments.ts:667 | Interactive | Webhook refund created | Default |
| 10 | payments.ts:755 | Interactive | Webhook refund processed | Default |
| 11 | orders.ts:178 | Interactive | Order cancellation (stock restore) | Default |
| 12 | returns.ts:330 | Interactive | Return processing (refund + stock) | Default |
| 13 | refunds.ts:239 | Array | Refund completion | Default |
| 14 | cart.ts:171 | Interactive | Cart sync (delete + recreate) | Default |
| 15 | cart.ts:246 | Interactive | Cart merge (race condition prevention) | Default |
| 16 | admin/products.ts:459 | Array | Batch variant upsert | Default |
| 17 | admin/lookbooks.ts:180 | Interactive | Lookbook update + items sync | Default |
| 18 | admin/lookbooks.ts:333 | Array | Lookbook item reorder | Default |
| 19 | admin/cms.ts:367 | Array | Homepage section reorder | Default |
| 20 | admin/orders.ts:223 | Interactive | Admin order status change | Default |
| 21 | admin/inventory.ts:102 | Interactive | Stock adjustment (read-validate-write) | Default |
| 22 | admin/related-products.ts:78 | Array | Related products reorder | Default |
| 23 | media/transaction.service.ts:42 | Interactive | Permanent media delete (Cloudinary + DB) | Default |
| 24 | media/transaction.service.ts:221 | Interactive | Media soft delete + cache invalidation | Default |
| 25 | media/transaction.service.ts:278 | Interactive | Media restore + cache invalidation | Default |
| 26 | job-queue.ts:202 | Array | Dead letter queue move | Default |
| 27 | scripts/reset-storage.ts:397 | Array | Batch counting | Default |
| 28 | transaction.ts:28-78 | Wrapper | `withTransaction()` utility | Configurable |
| 29 | transaction.ts:83-117 | Wrapper | `withTransactionAndRollback()` utility | Configurable |

### Transaction Abstraction Layer

**File**: `api/_lib/transaction.ts`

| Function | Purpose | Options |
|----------|---------|---------|
| `withTransaction()` | Wraps callback with retry logic | maxRetries, isolationLevel, timeout |
| `withTransactionAndRollback()` | Transaction with explicit rollback | Same as above |
| `atomicOperations()` | Executes multiple operations atomically | Same as above |

**Default Isolation Level**: `ReadCommitted`
**Default Timeout**: 10,000ms (both maxWait and timeout)

### Critical Transaction Patterns

1. **Idempotent Webhook Processing**: Check current state before mutating
2. **Stock Reservation**: Atomic decrement stock + increment reservedStock
3. **Stock Release**: Atomic increment stock + decrement reservedStock
4. **Cart Sync**: Delete all + recreate atomically
5. **Session Rotation**: Create new + revoke old atomically
6. **Media Permanent Delete**: Cloudinary delete + DB delete atomically
7. **Order Status Change**: Update + history + notification atomically

### Deadlock Risks

| Risk | Severity | Mitigation |
|------|----------|------------|
| Concurrent stock decrements | Medium | Transaction timeout + retry logic |
| Cart sync race conditions | Low | Atomic cart_items delete+recreate |
| Coupon redemption race | Low | Composite unique constraint + transaction |
| Webhook duplicate processing | Low | Idempotency check at transaction start |

## QUERY ANALYSIS

### Heavy Queries

| Query Pattern | Tables | Complexity | Mitigation |
|---------------|--------|------------|------------|
| Product listing with filters | products + variants + images + brands + categories | High | Composite indexes, pagination |
| Full-text search | products + categories + brands (GIN) | Medium | pg_trgm GIN indexes |
| Order history with items | orders + order_items + variants + products | Medium | Composite indexes |
| Admin dashboard aggregation | orders + products + users | High | Denormalized counts, caching |
| Cart merge on login | cart_items + carts | Medium | Transaction, atomic operations |
| Media usage detection | media_assets + all entity tables | High | usageCache field |
| Coupon validation | coupons + coupon_redemptions | Medium | Composite unique index |

### Search Query Pattern

```sql
-- Fuzzy product search using pg_trgm
SELECT *, similarity(name, $query) AS rank
FROM products
WHERE similarity(name, $query) > 0.1
ORDER BY rank DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

### Filtering Patterns

- **Category filter**: `WHERE categoryId = $id AND isActive = true`
- **Gender filter**: `WHERE gender = $gender AND isActive = true`
- **Price filter**: `WHERE basePrice BETWEEN $min AND $max AND isActive = true`
- **Brand filter**: `WHERE brandId = $id AND isActive = true`
- **Collection filter**: `WHERE collectionId = $id AND isActive = true`
- **Combined**: All filters composable via AND

### Sorting Patterns

- **Newest**: `ORDER BY createdAt DESC`
- **Price low-high**: `ORDER BY basePrice ASC`
- **Price high-low**: `ORDER BY basePrice DESC`
- **Popularity**: (future: order count or view count)
- **Admin**: `ORDER BY createdAt DESC` or `ORDER BY status, createdAt`

### Pagination Pattern

- **Cursor-based**: Use `createdAt` or `id` as cursor
- **Offset-based**: `SKIP $offset LIMIT $limit`
- **Recommended**: Cursor-based for large datasets

## DATA INTEGRITY

### Validation Rules

| Rule | Type | Implementation |
|------|------|---------------|
| Email format | Application | Email validation in API handlers |
| SKU uniqueness | Database | Unique constraint on product_variants.sku |
| Slug uniqueness | Database | Unique constraints on all slug fields |
| Stock non-negative | Application | Transaction validates `stock >= 0` |
| Price non-negative | Application | API validation |
| Order total calculation | Application | `subtotal + shippingCost + tax - discount = total` |
| Coupon usage limits | Application | Transaction checks `usedCount < usageLimit` |
| Review uniqueness | Database | Composite unique `(productId, profileId, orderId)` |
| Cart uniqueness | Database | Unique `profileId` on carts |
| Cart item uniqueness | Database | Unique `(cartId, variantId)` |

### Referential Integrity

All foreign keys defined in Prisma schema enforce referential integrity at the database level.

### Cascade Rules Summary

| Cascade Type | Tables |
|-------------|--------|
| **Cascade (delete children)** | profiles→addresses, profiles→sessions, profiles→cart, profiles→reviews, profiles→wishlist, profiles→couponRedemptions, profiles→searchHistory, products→variants, products→images, products→attributes, products→relatedProducts, products→tags, products→labels, categories→subcategories, orders→orderItems, orders→statusHistory, orders→refunds, orders→returnRequests, coupons→couponRedemptions, lookbooks→lookbookItems, support_tickets→replies, cart→cartItems |
| **SetNull (preserve parent)** | profiles→orders, profiles→notifications, profiles→support_tickets, profiles→loginAttempts, profiles→verificationAttempts, profiles→userActionLogs, profiles→orderStatusHistory(createdBy), profiles→refunds(initiatedBy), categories→products, categories→sizeGuides, subcategories→products, collections→products, brands→products, product_variants→orderItems(variantId), product_variants→productImages(variantId), lookbookItems→products, orders→addresses, orders→notifications, orders→supportTickets, orders→webhookEvents |
| **Restrict (prevent delete)** | products→orderItems (cannot delete product with orders) |

### Soft Delete Strategy

| Table | Soft Delete Field | Restore Field | Permanent Delete |
|-------|-------------------|---------------|------------------|
| media_assets | `deletedAt` | `deletedAt = NULL` | Hard delete after audit |

**Soft Delete Process:**
1. Set `deletedAt = now()`, `deletedBy = userId`, `deletedReason`
2. Asset excluded from normal queries (`WHERE deletedAt IS NULL`)
3. Restore: set `deletedAt = NULL`
4. Permanent: delete from DB + Cloudinary

### Archiving Strategy

| Table | Archive Strategy | Timeline |
|-------|-----------------|----------|
| analytics_events | Partition by month or archive old records | > 12 months |
| login_attempts | Archive old records | > 6 months |
| user_action_logs | Archive old records | > 12 months |
| media_audit_logs | Archive old records | > 12 months |
| job_queue (completed) | Move to completed archive | > 30 days |
| webhook_events | Archive processed events | > 90 days |
| notifications (read) | Archive read notifications | > 6 months |

## DATABASE SECURITY

### Connection Security

- **TLS Required**: Neon serverless enforces TLS
- **Connection Pooling**: Via `DATABASE_URL_POOLED` (Neon pooler)
- **Environment Isolation**: Separate DATABASE_URL per environment

### Access Control

- **Application Service Account**: Single database user with full CRUD permissions
- **No Direct Admin Access**: All admin operations through API handlers
- **API Key Management**: `api_keys` table with versioning, expiry, deprecation

### Secrets Management

| Secret | Location | Rotation |
|--------|----------|----------|
| DATABASE_URL | Environment variable | Quarterly |
| DATABASE_URL_POOLED | Environment variable | Quarterly |
| Supabase JWT Secret | Environment variable | Quarterly |
| Razorpay Key | Environment variable | Annually |
| Cloudinary credentials | Environment variable | Annually |

### Backup Strategy

**File**: `scripts/backup-database.ts`

| Feature | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| Full Backup | `pg_dump` with gzip compression |
| Schema-Only | `--schema-only` flag |
| Data-Only | `--data-only` flag |
| Encryption | AES-256-CBC |
| Integrity | SHA-256 checksums |
| Retention | 30 days default |
| Cloud Upload | Optional S3/GCS |

### Restore Strategy

**File**: `scripts/restore-database.ts`

| Feature | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| Decompression | Gunzip |
| Decryption | AES-256-CBC |
| Integrity Check | SHA-256 verification |
| Dry Run | Optional preview |
| Selective Restore | Table-level filtering |

### Disaster Recovery

| Scenario | Recovery Time | Recovery Point |
|----------|---------------|----------------|
| Database corruption | 30 min | Last backup (24h) |
| Accidental data loss | 15 min | Last backup (24h) |
| Schema migration failure | 5 min | Rollback migration |
| Complete database loss | 60 min | Last backup (24h) |
| Region failure | 5 min | Neon automatic failover |

## RISK MATRIX

### Critical Risks

| Risk | Impact | Probability | Mitigation |
|------|--------|-------------|------------|
| Stock overselling under high concurrency | High | Medium | Transaction timeout + retry + optimistic locking |
| Payment webhook duplication | High | Low | Idempotency check via webhook_events unique constraint |
| Data loss from cascade deletes | High | Low | Careful cascade rules; RESTRICT on critical FKs |

### High Risks

| Risk | Impact | Probability | Mitigation |
|------|--------|-------------|------------|
| Cart race conditions (multiple devices) | Medium | Medium | Atomic cart sync transaction |
| Coupon double-spending | Medium | Low | Composite unique constraint + transaction |
| Media DB/Cloudinary desync | Medium | Low | Transaction service + drift detection |
| Session token reuse after rotation | Medium | Low | Token rotation with revocation |

### Medium Risks

| Risk | Impact | Probability | Mitigation |
|------|--------|-------------|------------|
| Search performance degradation at scale | Medium | Medium | GIN trigram indexes, pagination |
| Analytics table bloat | Medium | High | Partitioning, archival strategy |
| Job queue dead letters accumulating | Low | Medium | Dead letter cleanup job |
| Soft-deleted media accumulating storage costs | Medium | Medium | Scheduled Cloudinary cleanup |

### Low Risks

| Risk | Impact | Probability | Mitigation |
|------|--------|-------------|------------|
| CMS content inconsistency | Low | Low | Transaction for reordering |
| Notification delivery failure | Low | Medium | Retry count + error message logging |
| FAQ ordering inconsistency | Low | Low | Sort order index |

## Executive Summary

### Backend Purpose

The NABOME backend is a **Cloudflare Pages Functions** API serving a premium D2C e-commerce platform. It operates on Cloudflare's edge compute runtime, connecting to Neon PostgreSQL via Prisma ORM, with external integrations for authentication (Supabase), payments (Razorpay), email (Resend), and media (Cloudinary).

### Backend Metrics

| Metric | Value |
|--------|:-----:|
| Total API files | ~106 |
| Handler modules | 62 (29 customer-facing + 33 admin) |
| Library modules | 44 |
| API endpoints | 245+ |
| Line count (handlers) | ~12,000 |
| Line count (libraries) | ~6,500 |
| Line count (router) | 826 |
| External services | 5 (Supabase, Razorpay, Resend, Cloudinary, Neon) |
| Database models accessed | 34+ |
| Transactions used | 22+ sites across 14 handlers |
| Zod validation schemas | 30+ |
| Email template types | 13 |
| Audit-logged actions | 22+ handlers |

## Backend Architecture Overview

### Request Lifecycle

```
1. Client sends request to /api/products
2. Cloudflare Pages routes to functions/api/[[path]].ts
3. Proxy delegates to api/[...path].ts handleRequest()
4. Router: generates request ID (crypto.randomUUID())
5. Router: strips /v1/ prefix if present
6. Router: logs incoming request
7. Router: validates body size (5MB default, 20MB for uploads)
8. Router: matches route via regex pattern against routes[] array
9. Router: checks if CSRF validation needed (POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH)
10. Router: validates CSRF token (exempts webhooks, auth, uploads)
11. Router: calls authenticate() if route requires auth
12. Auth: reads access_token from httpOnly cookie
13. Auth: verifies Supabase JWT
14. Auth: looks up session in Prisma auth_sessions table
15. Auth: checks idle timeout (8h admin, 2h customer)
16. Auth: updates session lastActiveAt
17. Router: calls requireAdmin() if route requires admin
18. Router: applies rate limiting (per-IP + per-user via KV)
19. Router: verifies Turnstile token for sensitive endpoints
20. Router: executes handler function
21. Handler: parses request body (req.json())
22. Handler: validates input (Zod or manual)
23. Handler: queries database via Prisma
24. Handler: calls external services if needed
25. Handler: returns standardized response
26. Router: sets CSRF cookie on GET responses
27. Router: adds X-Request-ID header
28. Router: records metrics via healthMonitor
29. Router: logs response
30. Router: applies CORS headers
31. Router: applies security headers
32. Response returned to client
```

### Handler Pattern

Every handler follows a consistent pattern:

```typescript
// Handler signature
export async function handleXxxRequest(
  req: Request,
  ctx: RequestContext,
  params: URLParams,
  action: string
): Promise<Response> {
  try {
    // Optional: require admin
    const adminCheck = requireAdmin(ctx);
    if (adminCheck) return adminCheck;

    // Optional: parse body
    const body = await req.json();

    // Optional: validate input
    const validation = validateBody(req, schema);
    if (validation.response) return validation.response;

    // Switch on action
    switch (action) {
      case 'list': return handleList(req, ctx);
      case 'create': return handleCreate(req, ctx, body);
      case 'update': return handleUpdate(req, ctx, params, body);
      case 'delete': return handleDelete(req, ctx, params);
      default: return badRequest('Invalid action');
    }
  } catch (error) {
    return serverError(error);
  }
}
```

## API Router Architecture

### Router File: `api/[...path].ts` (826 lines)

**Entry Points:** `GET()`, `POST()`, `PUT()`, `DELETE()`, `PATCH()`, `OPTIONS()`

**Route Registration:** `route(method, pattern, handler, options)`

**Route Options:**
- `auth: true` — Requires authentication
- `admin: true` — Requires admin role
- `turnstile: true` — Requires Turnstile verification
- `rateLimit: 'auth' | 'standard' | 'admin' | 'contact'` — Rate limit preset

### Request Processing Pipeline

```
Request → Body Size Check → Route Match → CSRF → Auth → Admin → Rate Limit → Turnstile → Handler → Response
```

**Exemptions:**
- CSRF: Exempt for GET/HEAD/OPTIONS, webhooks, auth paths, upload paths
- Auth: Not required for public endpoints
- Admin: Not required for non-admin endpoints
- Rate Limit: Different presets per route type
- Turnstile: Only for sensitive auth endpoints (register, login, forgot-password, etc.)

## Route Documentation

### Public Auth Endpoints

#### POST /api/auth/register
- **Purpose:** Register new user account
- **Auth:** None
- **Turnstile:** Yes
- **Rate Limit:** auth (5/60s)
- **Body:** `{ email, password, firstName, lastName, phone }`
- **Validation:** `authRegisterSchema` (Zod)
- **Business Logic:**
  1. Verify Turnstile token
  2. Create user in Supabase Auth
  3. Create profile in Neon DB
  4. Generate 6-digit verification code (24h expiry)
  5. Send verification email via Resend
  6. Create auth_session record
  7. Set access_token (15min), refresh_token (30d), csrf_token cookies
  8. Log registration event
- **Response:** `{ user: { id, email, firstName, lastName, role } }`
- **Database:** `profiles`, `auth_sessions`, `verification_attempts`
- **External:** Supabase Auth, Resend

#### POST /api/auth/login
- **Purpose:** Authenticate user
- **Auth:** None
- **Turnstile:** Yes
- **Rate Limit:** auth (5/60s)
- **Body:** `{ email, password }`
- **Validation:** `authLoginSchema` (Zod)
- **Business Logic:**
  1. Verify Turnstile token
  2. Authenticate via Supabase `signInWithPassword`
  3. Fetch profile from database
  4. Create auth_session (hashed token)
  5. Set 3 cookies (access, refresh, csrf)
  6. Log login attempt (success/failure)
  7. Brute-force protection: 5 failed attempts → 30min lockout
- **Response:** `{ user: { id, email, firstName, lastName, role, emailVerified } }`
- **Database:** `profiles`, `auth_sessions`, `login_attempts`
- **External:** Supabase Auth

#### POST /api/auth/logout
- **Purpose:** End user session
- **Auth:** Yes (optional — works with or without)
- **Business Logic:**
  1. Invalidate auth_session in DB
  2. Clear all 3 cookies
- **Response:** `{ success: true }`
- **Database:** `auth_sessions`

#### POST /api/auth/refresh
- **Purpose:** Refresh access token
- **Auth:** No (reads refresh_token from cookie)
- **Business Logic:**
  1. Read refresh_token from httpOnly cookie
  2. Validate session in DB
  3. Create new session (token rotation)
  4. Invalidate old session
  5. Set new cookies
- **Response:** `{ success: true }`
- **Database:** `auth_sessions`

#### POST /api/auth/forgot-password
- **Purpose:** Send password reset code
- **Auth:** None
- **Turnstile:** Yes
- **Rate Limit:** auth (5/60s)
- **Body:** `{ email }`
- **Business Logic:**
  1. Generate 6-digit code
  2. Store in `verification_attempts` (24h expiry, max 5 attempts)
  3. Send email via Resend
- **Response:** `{ message: "Reset code sent" }`

#### POST /api/auth/verify-reset-code
- **Purpose:** Verify password reset code
- **Auth:** None
- **Turnstile:** Yes
- **Body:** `{ email, code }`

#### POST /api/auth/reset-password
- **Purpose:** Set new password
- **Auth:** None
- **Turnstile:** Yes
- **Body:** `{ email, code, newPassword }`
- **Business Logic:**
  1. Verify code against `verification_attempts`
  2. Update password in Supabase Auth
  3. Invalidate ALL user sessions (transactional)
- **Database:** `verification_attempts`, `auth_sessions`

#### POST /api/auth/change-password
- **Purpose:** Change password (authenticated)
- **Auth:** Yes
- **Body:** `{ currentPassword, newPassword }`

#### GET /api/auth/me
- **Purpose:** Get current user profile
- **Auth:** Yes

#### PUT /api/auth/me
- **Purpose:** Update profile fields
- **Auth:** Yes

#### GET /api/auth/sessions
- **Purpose:** List active sessions
- **Auth:** Yes
- **Business Logic:** IP addresses masked for privacy

#### DELETE /api/auth/sessions/:id
- **Purpose:** Revoke specific session
- **Auth:** Yes

#### POST /api/auth/verify-email
- **Purpose:** Verify email with 6-digit code
- **Auth:** None
- **Turnstile:** Yes

#### POST /api/auth/resend-verification
- **Purpose:** Resend verification email
- **Auth:** None

#### POST /api/cart/merge
- **Purpose:** Merge guest cart with server cart
- **Auth:** No (guest support)
- **Business Logic:** Upsert per-item (add new, increment existing)

#### DELETE /api/cart
- **Purpose:** Clear all cart items
- **Auth:** Yes

#### POST /api/checkout
- **Purpose:** Place order (authenticated)
- **Auth:** Yes (email verified required)
- **Body:** `{ items, addressId, couponCode?, shippingAddress?, billingAddress? }`
- **Business Logic (730 lines):**
  1. Validate cart items (stock check)
  2. Resolve addresses (existing or create new)
  3. Validate coupon (active, date range, usage limit, gender, min order)
  4. Calculate: subtotal, shipping (free >999 INR, else 99 INR), tax (configurable %), discount
  5. Create Razorpay order (BEFORE DB transaction)
  6. Create order + items + status history in transaction
  7. Reserve stock (stock -= qty, reservedStock += qty)
  8. Record inventory movements
  9. Create coupon redemption record
  10. Clear cart
  11. Send order confirmation email
- **Response:** `{ orderId, razorpayOrderId, orderNumber, total }`

#### POST /api/checkout/guest
- **Purpose:** Place order as guest (email required, no auth)
- **Auth:** No
- **Business Logic:** Creates guest profile with `preferences: { guest: true }`

#### POST /api/payments/verify
- **Purpose:** Verify Razorpay payment signature
- **Auth:** Yes
- **Body:** `{ razorpay_order_id, razorpay_payment_id, razorpay_signature, orderId }`
- **Business Logic:**
  1. Verify HMAC-SHA256 signature (timing-safe comparison)
  2. Update order: status=confirmed, paymentStatus=paid
  3. Create status history
  4. Send payment success email
- **Database:** `orders`, `order_status_history`, `notifications`

#### POST /api/payments/failed
- **Purpose:** Record failed payment + release inventory
- **Auth:** Yes
- **Business Logic:**
  1. Update order: paymentStatus=failed
  2. Release reserved stock
  3. Record inventory movements
  4. Send payment failure email

#### POST /api/payments/retry
- **Purpose:** Create new Razorpay order for retry
- **Auth:** Yes

#### POST /api/payments/webhook
- **Purpose:** Razorpay webhook receiver
- **Auth:** HMAC-SHA256 signature verification
- **Business Logic:**
  1. Verify webhook signature
  2. Deduplicate via `webhook_events` table
  3. Process payment.captured, payment.failed events
  4. Return 200 for all events (Razorpay requirement)

## Service Layer Documentation

### Authentication Service (`api/_lib/auth-middleware.ts` — 266 lines)

**Purpose:** JWT verification, session management, role-based access control

**Key Functions:**
- `authenticate(request, options?, env?)` — Main auth function; returns `{ ctx: RequestContext }` or `Response` error
- `optionalAuth(request, env?)` — Lightweight wrapper; returns empty context on failure
- `requireRole(context, role)` — Post-auth role check
- `requireAdmin(context)` — Post-auth admin check

**Middleware Pipeline:**
1. Rate limiting (per-user)
2. CSRF validation
3. JWT verification (from httpOnly cookie)
4. Session lookup in Prisma (with idle timeout)
5. Email verification check (optional)
6. Role check (optional)

**Session Management:**
- Idle timeout: 8h admin, 2h customer
- Token hashing (SHA-256) with backward-compatible unhashed fallback
- Session update on every authenticated request (lastActiveAt)

**Dependencies:** Supabase (JWT verify), Prisma (sessions), rate-limit, csrf, cookies, token-hash

### Email Service (`api/_lib/email.ts` — 254 lines)

**Purpose:** Transactional email sending via Resend API

**Key Functions:**
- `sendEmailNotification(type, data, env?, sync?)` — Main email function
- `testEmail(env, to)` — Test configuration

**Features:**
- Sync mode for critical emails (password reset)
- Async mode via job queue for others
- 3 retries with exponential backoff
- Admin notification forwarding for customer-facing events
- Self-contained (no Prisma dependency for resilience)

**Email Types (13):** welcome, email_verification, email_change, order_confirmation, payment_success, payment_failure, shipping_update, delivery_confirmation, password_reset, admin_new_order, admin_refund_request, admin_contact_form, notification

**Dependencies:** Resend API (direct HTTP), email-templates, job-queue

### Cache Service (`api/_lib/cache.ts` — 237 lines)

**Purpose:** Dual-mode caching (Cloudflare KV production / in-memory development)

**Key Functions:**
- `CacheService.get()`, `.set()`, `.delete()`, `.invalidateByTag()`, `.invalidateByPrefix()`
- `withCache(cacheService, prefix, key, options?)` — HOF middleware for Response caching
- `CacheKeys` — Predefined key generators
- `CacheTags` — Predefined tag constants

**Features:**
- Tag-based invalidation
- `X-Cache: HIT/MISS` header on responses
- Periodic in-memory cleanup (60s interval)

**Status:** Defined but not actively used in handlers

### Job Queue Service (`api/_lib/job-queue.ts` — 314 lines)

**Purpose:** Database-backed job queue with retry and dead-letter support

**Key Functions:**
- `enqueueJob(jobType, payload, options, env)` — Create job record
- `processJob(jobId, env)` — Execute single job
- `getNextJobs(limit, env)` — Fetch pending/retry-ready jobs
- `processJobBatch(limit, env)` — Batch processing
- `getJobQueueStats(env)` — Queue statistics

**Job Types:** send_email (implemented), newsletter_subscribe (implemented), newsletter_unsubscribe (implemented), process_analytics (stub), cleanup_media (stub), generate_report (stub)

**Retry:** Exponential backoff (2^n minutes), dead-letter after max retries

## Middleware Documentation

### Request Middleware Stack (Applied in Order)

| # | Middleware | Module | Scope | Purpose |
|---|-----------|--------|:-----:|---------|
| 1 | Body Size Check | `api/[...path].ts` | All POST/PUT | 5MB default, 20MB for uploads |
| 2 | CSRF Validation | `csrf.ts` | POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH | Double-submit cookie pattern |
| 3 | Authentication | `auth-middleware.ts` | Protected endpoints | Supabase JWT + session lookup |
| 4 | Admin Check | `auth-middleware.ts` | Admin endpoints | Role-based access |
| 5 | Rate Limiting | `rate-limit.ts` | All endpoints | KV-backed sliding window |
| 6 | Turnstile | `turnstile.ts` | Sensitive auth endpoints | Bot protection |
| 7 | Input Validation | `validate.ts` | POST/PUT endpoints | Zod schema validation |

### Response Middleware (Applied to All Responses)

| # | Middleware | Module | Purpose |
|---|-----------|--------|---------|
| 1 | CSRF Cookie | `csrf.ts` | Set csrf_token cookie on GET responses |
| 2 | Request ID | `api/[...path].ts` | X-Request-ID header |
| 3 | API Version | `api/[...path].ts` | X-API-Version header |
| 4 | CORS | `http-headers.ts` | Access-Control headers |
| 5 | Security Headers | `security-headers.ts` | CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, etc. |
| 6 | Cache Control | `http-headers.ts` | Path-based cache rules |
| 7 | Metrics | `health-monitor.ts` | Record request metrics |

### CSRF Protection (`csrf.ts` — 98 lines)

**Pattern:** Double-submit cookie

**Implementation:**
- Token in non-httpOnly cookie (JS-readable) + matching `X-CSRF-Token` header
- SameSite=Strict cookies (mitigates most CSRF by default)
- GET/HEAD/OPTIONS exempted
- Webhooks, auth paths, uploads exempted

**Status:** Enforced (previously dead code, now active)

### Rate Limiting (`rate-limit.ts` — 160 lines)

**Pattern:** Sliding window with KV distributed storage

**Presets:**
| Preset | Limit | Window |
|--------|:-----:|:------:|
| auth | 5 req | 60s |
| standard | 30 req | 10s |
| admin | 60 req | 60s |
| contact | 3 req | 3600s |
| resendVerification | 3 req | 3600s |

**Degradation:** KV → in-memory → no-limit (local dev)

**Known Issue:** Falls open on KV miss (allows unlimited requests)

### Security Headers (`security-headers.ts` — 175 lines)

**Headers Applied:**
- Content-Security-Policy (nonce-based)
- Strict-Transport-Security (production only)
- X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
- X-Frame-Options: DENY
- Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin
- Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()
- Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy
- Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy
- Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy

### Edge Middleware (`functions/_middleware.ts` — 610 lines)

**Purpose:** SEO meta tag injection at Cloudflare Edge

**Features:**
- HTML interception + meta tag injection
- JSON-LD structured data (WebSite, Organization, Product, Collection, Article, FAQ, BreadcrumbList)
- In-memory SEO data cache (10s TTL, 500 entries)
- Canonical URL redirect (trailing slash removal)
- SPA fallback (serves /index.html for 404 HTML responses)
- Page-specific SEO (products, categories, collections, lookbooks, FAQ, static pages)

## Business Logic Documentation

### Authentication Workflows

#### Registration Flow
```
1. User submits form (email, password, firstName, lastName, phone)
2. Turnstile validates (bot check)
3. POST /api/auth/register
4. Handler: validateInput (Zod)
5. Handler: Supabase Auth → createUser()
6. Handler: Prisma → create profile
7. Handler: Generate 6-digit code (24h expiry)
8. Handler: Store in verification_attempts
9. Handler: Send verification email via Resend
10. Handler: Create auth_session
11. Handler: Set 3 cookies (access, refresh, csrf)
12. Response: user data + success message
13. Frontend: AuthLoader → GET /api/auth/me → hydrate store
```

#### Login Flow
```
1. User submits email + password
2. Turnstile validates
3. POST /api/auth/login
4. Handler: Supabase → signInWithPassword()
5. Handler: Fetch profile from DB
6. Handler: Create auth_session (hashed token)
7. Handler: Set 3 cookies
8. Handler: Log login attempt (success/failure)
9. Brute-force check: 5 failures → 30min lockout
10. Response: user profile
11. Frontend: Zustand store updated via setAuth()
12. Frontend: Guest cart merged with server cart
```

#### Token Refresh Flow
```
1. Frontend detects token expiry (every 30s)
2. POST /api/auth/refresh (reads refresh_token from cookie)
3. Handler: Validate session in DB
4. Handler: Create new session (token rotation)
5. Handler: Invalidate old session
6. Handler: Set new cookies
7. Response: success
8. If 401: Force logout via auth:logout custom event
```

### Checkout Flow
```
1. User reviews cart
2. Optionally applies coupon (POST /api/coupons/validate)
3. POST /api/checkout
4. Handler: Validate cart items (stock check)
5. Handler: Resolve addresses (existing or create new)
6. Handler: Validate coupon (active, date, usage, gender, min order)
7. Handler: Calculate subtotal
8. Handler: Calculate shipping (free >999 INR, else 99 INR)
9. Handler: Calculate tax (subtotal - discount) * taxRate / 100
10. Handler: Calculate total
11. Handler: Create Razorpay order (BEFORE DB transaction)
12. Handler: BEGIN TRANSACTION
13.   Handler: Create order record
14.   Handler: Create order_items
15.   Handler: Create order_status_history
16.   Handler: Reserve stock (stock -= qty, reservedStock += qty)
17.   Handler: Record inventory movements
18.   Handler: Create coupon redemption
19.   Handler: Clear cart
20. Handler: COMMIT TRANSACTION
21. Handler: Send order confirmation email
22. Response: { orderId, razorpayOrderId, orderNumber, total }
23. Frontend: Razorpay checkout modal opens
24. User completes payment
25. POST /api/payments/verify
26. Handler: Verify HMAC-SHA256 signature
27. Handler: Update order (confirmed, paid)
28. Handler: Create status history
29. Handler: Send payment success email
30. Response: order data
```

### Payment Flow
```
Razorpay Integration:
├── Order Creation (in checkout handler)
│   POST /v1/orders → { amount, currency: "INR", receipt }
│
├── Payment Verification
│   POST /api/payments/verify
│   HMAC-SHA256(order_id + "|" + payment_id, secret)
│
├── Webhook Processing
│   POST /api/payments/webhook
│   Signature: HMAC-SHA256(body, webhook_secret)
│   Events: payment.captured, payment.failed
│   Idempotency: webhook_events table upsert
│
├── Refund Processing
│   POST /api/payments/refund (admin only)
│   Razorpay POST /v1/refunds → { amount, payment_id }
│
└── Failure Handling
    POST /api/payments/failed
    Release reserved stock + inventory movements
```

### Order Status State Machine
```
pending → confirmed → processing → packed → shipped → out_for_delivery → delivered
    ↓         ↓           ↓          ↓         ↓              ↓
  cancelled  cancelled  cancelled  cancelled  returned     returned
                                           ↘ refunded    ↘ refunded

ORDER_STATUS_FLOW = {
  pending: ['confirmed', 'cancelled'],
  confirmed: ['processing', 'cancelled'],
  processing: ['packed', 'cancelled'],
  packed: ['shipped', 'cancelled'],
  shipped: ['out_for_delivery', 'returned'],
  out_for_delivery: ['delivered', 'returned'],
  delivered: ['returned', 'refunded'],
  returned: ['refunded'],
  cancelled: [],
  refunded: []
}
```

### Inventory Management
```
Stock Lifecycle:
├── Product Creation: stock = initial_stock, reservedStock = 0
├── Checkout: stock -= qty, reservedStock += qty (transactional)
├── Payment Success: reservedStock unchanged (stock stays reduced)
├── Payment Failure: stock += qty, reservedStock -= qty (release)
├── Order Cancellation: stock += qty, reservedStock -= qty
├── Order Delivery: reservedStock -= qty (stock stays reduced)
└── Refund: stock += qty (if physical return)

Inventory Movements Table:
├── variantId: which variant
├── quantityChange: +N or -N
├── reason: purchase, sale, return, adjustment, reservation, release
├── reference: order ID or admin note
└── performedBy: user ID or 'system'
```

### Media Upload Flow
```
1. Admin selects file in Media Library
2. POST /api/admin/media/upload (multipart/form-data)
3. Validate: MIME type (JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP, TIFF)
4. Validate: File size (images 10MB, video 100MB, docs 5MB)
5. Validate: Magic-byte file signature
6. Generate asset ID (asset_XXXXXXXXX)
7. Build Cloudinary folder path (nabome/{entityType}/{slug}/{assetId})
8. Upload to Cloudinary (signed request with SHA-1 signature)
9. Create media_assets record in DB
10. Log audit action
11. Response: asset with URL + publicId
```

### Search Flow
```
Product Search:
├── Basic: Prisma contains (ILIKE) on name, description, material, brand, SKU, tags
├── Suggestions: pg_trgm raw SQL with weighted similarity scoring
│   ├── product name × 10
│   ├── short description × 5
│   └── category name × 3
├── Autocomplete: Top 8 results from products, categories, brands
├── Trending: Upsert-based counter in trending_searches table
└── History: Per-user search_history (capped at 20)

Note: Current search is ILIKE-based, not full-text. pg_trgm extension required for suggestions.
```

- **Anon Client:** Anon key (respects RLS)

- **API:** REST (https://api.resend.com/)
- **Auth:** Bearer token
- **Operations:** Send email
- **Retry:** 3 attempts with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s)

- **API:** REST (signed requests with SHA-1)
- **Auth:** API key + secret (signature generation)
- **Operations:** Upload, delete, folder management

- **Adapter:** @prisma/adapter-neon
- **Connection:** Pooled (DATABASE_URL_POOLED)

- **Extensions:** pg_trgm (fuzzy search), pgcrypto

## Validation Architecture

### Validation Layers

| Layer | Where | What | Tool |
|-------|-------|------|------|
| 1. Body Size | Router | Request body size | Manual check |
| 2. CSRF | Router | State-changing requests | Double-submit cookie |
| 3. Input Schema | Handler | Request body/query/params | Zod schemas |
| 4. Business Rules | Handler | Domain-specific validation | Manual logic |
| 5. Database | Prisma | Constraints, unique, FK | Schema-level |

### Zod Schema Usage

**Current State:** 30+ schemas defined in `validate.ts`, but only ~5 handlers use `validateBody()`

**Handlers WITH Zod validation:**
- auth.ts (8 schemas)
- payments.ts (4 schemas)
- contact.ts (2 schemas)
- checkout.ts (1 schema)

**Handlers WITHOUT Zod validation (100+ req.json() calls):**
- All admin handlers
- cart.ts, orders.ts, reviews.ts, wishlist.ts, addresses.ts
- support.ts, notifications.ts, dashboard.ts
- Most customer-facing handlers

### Business Validation Rules

| Rule | Where | Implementation |
|------|-------|----------------|
| Stock availability | checkout.ts | `stock >= quantity` check in transaction |
| Coupon validity | coupons.ts | Active, date range, usage limit, gender, min order |
| Order status transitions | orders.ts | State machine validation |
| Address uniqueness | checkout.ts | Deduplication before create |
| Review duplication | reviews.ts | Composite unique key |
| Slug uniqueness | products.ts, categories.ts | Check + timestamp suffix |
| Email uniqueness | auth.ts | Supabase handles |
| Password complexity | validate.ts | Uppercase, lowercase, digit, special, 8-128 chars |

## Security Architecture

### Security Layers

```
Layer 7: Monitoring    — Sentry (STUBBED), audit logs, rate limit monitoring
Layer 6: Application   — Input validation, output encoding, business logic
Layer 5: Authorization — RBAC, resource ownership, field-level permissions
Layer 4: Authentication — JWT, sessions, password hashing, token rotation
Layer 3: Transport     — HTTPS, HSTS, CORS, security headers, CSP
Layer 2: Infrastructure — Cloudflare WAF, DDoS protection, rate limiting
Layer 1: Secrets       — Environment variables, key rotation
```

### Security Headers (Applied to All Responses)

| Header | Value | Purpose |
|--------|-------|---------|
| Content-Security-Policy | Restrictive with allowed domains | XSS prevention |
| Strict-Transport-Security | max-age=31536000; preload | HTTPS enforcement |
| X-Content-Type-Options | nosniff | MIME sniffing prevention |
| X-Frame-Options | DENY | Clickjacking prevention |
| Referrer-Policy | strict-origin-when-cross-origin | Referrer leakage |
| Permissions-Policy | camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=() | Feature policy |

### Authentication Security

| Component | Implementation | Status |
|-----------|---------------|:------:|
| Password storage | Supabase Auth (bcrypt) | ✅ |
| JWT tokens | httpOnly cookies | ✅ |
| Token expiry | 15min access, 30d refresh | ✅ |
| Token rotation | Refresh on use | ✅ |
| Session management | Prisma auth_sessions | ✅ |
| Session hashing | SHA-256 | ✅ |
| CSRF protection | Double-submit cookie | ✅ |
| Rate limiting | KV-backed sliding window | ✅ |
| Turnstile | Bot protection | ✅ |
| Input validation | Zod (partial) | ⚠️ 5% coverage |
| Error monitoring | Sentry | ❌ Stubbed |
| Account lockout | 5 attempts → 30min | ✅ |

### Known Security Issues

| Issue | CVSS | Status | Description |
|-------|:----:|:------:|-------------|
| Secrets in git | 10.0 | UNFIXED | .env committed to repo |
| Sentry disabled | 9.0 | UNFIXED | All monitoring no-ops |
| No input validation | 8.0 | UNFIXED | 95% of endpoints unvalidated |
| SQL injection risk | 8.0 | UNFIXED | $queryRawUnsafe in soft-delete.ts |
| Rate limiting falls open | 7.5 | UNFIXED | Returns null on KV miss |
| No webhook idempotency | 8.5 | UNFIXED | Razorpay events can double-process |

## Performance Review

### Current Performance Metrics

| Metric | Value | Target | Status |
|--------|:-----:|:------:|:------:|
| TTFB (cold start) | 13.6s | <2s | ❌ Critical |
| Health endpoint error rate | 77% | <1% | ❌ Critical |
| Main JS bundle | 322KB | <350KB | ⚠️ |
| CSS bundle | 114KB | <120KB | ⚠️ |
| API response time (avg) | 48.5ms | <200ms | ✅ |

### Backend Performance Characteristics

**Strengths:**
- Singleton Prisma client (avoids connection pool exhaustion)
- Route-level caching (60s for products, 300s for CMS)
- Database indexes (80+ @@index declarations)
- Transaction support with retry + exponential backoff
- Cloudinary auto-optimization (f_auto, q_auto)

**Weaknesses:**
- Hyperdrive not active (direct Neon connection)
- No server-side query caching
- N+1 query patterns in admin/media.ts
- In-memory state fragility (logger, health monitor, query monitor)
- All 50+ handler imports at module top level (bundle size)
- No connection pooling at edge

### Database Query Patterns

| Pattern | Count | Risk |
|---------|:-----:|:----:|
| Prisma ORM queries | 200+ | Low (parameterized) |
| Raw SQL ($queryRawUnsafe) | 2 | High (injection risk) |
| $transaction usage | 22+ sites | Low |
| N+1 patterns | 3+ | Medium |
| Unbounded queries | 2 | Medium |
| Pagination | 15+ endpoints | Low |

## Error Handling

### Error Response Pattern

```typescript
// Every handler wraps in try/catch
try {
  // business logic
} catch (error) {
  return serverError(error); // Never exposes internals
}
```

### Error Categories

| Category | Handler | Response | Logging |
|----------|---------|----------|---------|
| Validation | `badRequest()` | 400 + details | No |
| Auth | `unauthorized()` | 401 | No |
| Permission | `forbidden()` | 403 | Audit log |
| Not Found | `notFound()` | 404 | No |
| Conflict | `conflict()` | 409 | Audit log |
| Rate Limit | `rateLimitExceeded()` | 429 | No |
| Server Error | `serverError()` | 500 generic | Sentry (stubbed) |

### Prisma Error Handling

| Error Code | Meaning | Handler |
|------------|---------|---------|
| P2025 | Record not found | `notFound()` response |
| P2002 | Unique constraint violation | `conflict()` response |
| P2003 | Foreign key violation | `badRequest()` response |
| P2014 | Required relation violation | `badRequest()` response |

### Known Error Handling Issues

| Issue | Location | Impact |
|-------|----------|--------|
| Sentry disabled | `sentry.ts` | Zero production error visibility |
| In-memory logs | `logger.ts` | Logs lost on cold start |
| console.error exposure | 30+ files | Error objects exposed to client |
| Silent catch blocks | `SearchOverlay.tsx`, others | Errors suppressed |
| serverError always generic | `response.ts` | Correct (no internal leak) |

    │             │            │── validateCart ──→│           │           │
    │             │            │── validateCoupon→│           │           │
    │             │            │── calculateTotals│           │           │
    │             │            │── createRazorpay ────────────→│         │
    │             │            │── BEGIN TXN       │           │           │
    │             │            │   ├── createOrder→│           │           │
    │             │            │   ├── createItems→│           │           │
    │             │            │   ├── reserveStock→│          │           │
    │             │            │   └── clearCart ──→│          │           │
    │             │            │── COMMIT TXN      │           │           │
    │             │            │── sendEmail ────────────────────────────→│
    │←── Response─────────────│                  │           │           │
```

### Payment Verification Flow
```
[Customer] → [Router] → [Payments Handler] → [Razorpay] → [Prisma] → [Resend]
    │             │            │                  │           │           │
    │── POST ───→│            │                  │           │           │
    │             │── Auth ──→│                   │           │           │
    │             │            │── verifySignature→│           │           │
    │             │            │── BEGIN TXN       │           │           │
    │             │            │   ├── updateOrder────────────→│          │
    │             │            │   └── createHistory──────────→│          │
    │             │            │── COMMIT TXN      │           │           │
    │             │            │── sendEmail ────────────────────────────→│
    │←── Response─────────────│                  │           │           │
```

Handlers → Services:

├── payments.ts → Prisma (orders, refunds, webhook_events, notifications), Razorpay, email, validate, audit
├── reviews.ts → Prisma (products, reviews)
├── coupons.ts → Prisma (coupons, coupon_redemptions)
├── search.ts → Prisma (raw SQL with pg_trgm), search_history, trending_searches
├── cms.ts → Prisma (homepage_sections, static_pages, navigation_menus, announcement_bars, footer_sections, orders)
├── support.ts → Prisma (support_tickets, support_ticket_replies, faqs), requireAdmin
├── notifications.ts → Prisma (notifications, notification_templates), email
├── dashboard.ts → Prisma (profiles, orders, wishlist_items, addresses, notifications, auth_sessions), Supabase Auth
├── returns.ts → Prisma (return_requests, orders, refunds, product_variants, inventory_movements, notifications)
├── refunds.ts → Prisma (refunds, orders, notifications)
├── invoices.ts → Prisma (orders, order_items, addresses, profiles)
├── data-export.ts → Prisma (12+ models), authenticate
├── upload.ts → media-service, validateFile, validateFileContent, requireAdmin

Admin Handlers → Services:
├── admin/products.ts → Prisma (10+ models), media-service, audit, sanitize, slugify
├── admin/orders.ts → Prisma (orders, order_status_history, product_variants, inventory_movements, notifications), email, audit
├── admin/media.ts → Prisma (media_assets + 10 entity tables), media/transaction, media/usage-cache, audit
├── admin/cms.ts → Prisma (CMS models), media-service, audit
├── admin/analytics.ts → Prisma (orders, order_items, profiles, products)
├── admin/inventory.ts → Prisma (product_variants, inventory_movements, inventory_alerts, site_settings), audit
└── ... (all admin handlers follow similar pattern)

Services → External:
├── email.ts → Resend API (direct HTTP, 3 retries)
├── media/cloudinary.ts → Cloudinary API (signed requests)
├── media/folders.ts → Cloudinary API (folder management)
├── auth-middleware.ts → Supabase Auth (admin + anon clients)
└── job-queue.ts → Prisma (job_queue, dead_letter_queue tables)
```

### Middleware Flow

```
Request → Body Size → Route Match → CSRF → Auth → Admin → Rate Limit → Turnstile → Handler → Response
                                                                   ↓
                                                              KV Check
                                                          ┌───────┴───────┐
                                                          │ Hit: Apply    │
                                                          │ Miss: Skip    │
                                                          └───────────────┘
```

### Authentication Flow

```
Cookie (access_token) → parseCookies → hashToken → prisma.auth_sessions.findUnique
    ↓                                                              ↓
Supabase JWT verify ← token from cookie                   Session found?
    ↓                                                          ↓
Valid JWT? ──No──→ 401                           Yes ──→ Check expiresAt
    ↓                                                      ↓
Yes ──→ Check emailVerified                      Expired? ──Yes──→ 401
            ↓                                          ↓
        Not verified? ──Yes──→ 403              Not expired?
            ↓                                          ↓
            No ──→ Check role                      Update lastActiveAt
                        ↓                              ↓
                    Admin? ──Yes──→ requireAdmin()   Return ctx
                        ↓
                        No ──→ Return ctx
```

## Risk Matrix

### Backend Risk Assessment

| Risk | Category | Severity | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation |
|------|----------|:--------:|:----------:|:------:|------------|
| Secrets in git | Security | Critical | Confirmed | Full compromise | Rotate + purge history |
| Sentry disabled | Monitoring | Critical | Confirmed | Zero visibility | Enable Sentry |
| No input validation | Security | Critical | Confirmed | Injection attacks | Add Zod to all endpoints |
| SQL injection | Security | Critical | Possible | DB compromise | Parameterize queries |
| Rate limit bypass | Security | High | Confirmed | Abuse | Fix KV fallback |
| N+1 queries | Performance | High | Confirmed | Slow responses | Eager loading |
| Cold start 13.6s | Performance | Critical | Confirmed | User abandonment | Enable Hyperdrive |
| 77% health errors | Reliability | Critical | Confirmed | Service degradation | Fix infrastructure |
| In-memory state loss | Reliability | High | Confirmed | Data loss on restart | External logging |
| Webhook double-process | Financial | High | Possible | Double payments | Add idempotency |
| Stubbed features | Functionality | Medium | Confirmed | Missing features | Implement or remove |
| Duplicated code | Maintainability | Medium | Confirmed | Tech debt | Extract shared modules |
| No caching layer | Performance | High | Confirmed | DB overload | Add KV caching |
| Type safety bypass | Code Quality | Medium | Confirmed | Runtime errors | Eliminate `any`/`as never` |
| Granular permissions unused | Security | Medium | Confirmed | Over-permissive | Enforce at router level |

## 8.1 Executive Summary

NABOME is a **React 19 + Vite + Tailwind CSS** single-page application (SPA) for a premium Bengali fashion brand (the name means "New Me" in Bengali). The frontend is deployed on **Cloudflare Pages** with server-side API handlers via Cloudflare Pages Functions.

### Key Metrics

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Total Page Components | 71 unique |
| Total Route Paths | 81 |
| Storefront Pages | 23 (unique components) |
| Customer Dashboard Pages | 10 |
| Admin Pages | 42 (unique components) |
| Auth Pages | 5 |
| Layout Files | 8 |
| Reusable UI Components | 16 (design system) |
| Storefront Components | 28 |
| Admin Common Components | 6 + 5 skeletons + 9 product-specific + 5 media + 2 CMS |
| Custom Hooks | 25 |
| Zustand Stores | 4 |
| Global Utility Files | 10 |
| Animation Keyframes | 10 |
| CSS Design Tokens | 20+ custom properties |
| Tailwind Theme Extensions | 100+ custom values |

### Technology Stack

| Category | Technology |
|----------|-----------|
| Framework | React 19.1 + React DOM 19.1 |
| Build Tool | Vite 6.3 |
| Routing | react-router-dom 7.5 |
| State Management | Zustand 5.0 |
| Data Fetching | @tanstack/react-query 5.75 |
| Styling | Tailwind CSS 3.4 + CVA + clsx + tailwind-merge |
| Animation | framer-motion 12.9 |
| Icons | lucide-react |
| Schema Validation | Zod 3.24 |
| i18n | i18next + react-i18next |
| SEO | react-helmet-async |
| Testing | Vitest 4.1 + @testing-library/react + Playwright |
| CSS Build | LightningCSS (via Vite) |

## 8.2 Frontend Architecture

### 8.2.1 Folder Structure

```
src/
├── app/                          # Application entry, routing, root component
│   ├── main.tsx                  # React root mount
│   ├── App.tsx                   # Root component (QueryClient, BrowserRouter, routes, providers)
│   └── routes.tsx                # All route definitions (STOREFRONT, AUTH, ADMIN)
│
├── pages/                        # Auth pages + shared page shells
│   ├── AuthShell.tsx
│   ├── LoginPage.tsx
│   ├── RegisterPage.tsx
│   ├── ForgotPasswordPage.tsx
│   ├── ResetPasswordPage.tsx
│   ├── VerifyEmailPage.tsx
│   └── NotFoundPage.tsx
│
├── components/                   # Shared/global components
│   ├── auth/                     # Route guards
│   ├── ui/                       # Design system primitives (16 components)
│   └── *.tsx                     # Global utilities (ErrorBoundary, Toast, etc.)
│
├── storefront/                   # Customer-facing feature module
│   ├── components/               # 28 storefront-specific components
│   ├── hooks/                    # 13 storefront hooks
│   ├── layout/                   # 7 layout components
│   ├── lib/                      # Storefront libraries
│   ├── pages/                    # 23 storefront pages
│   ├── sections/                 # 13 CMS-driven homepage sections
│   ├── store/                    # Connectivity store
│   └── stores/                   # Cart + UI stores
│
├── admin/                        # Admin panel feature module
│   ├── AdminRoutes.tsx           # 48 admin route definitions
│   ├── layout/                   # Admin layout
│   ├── common/                   # Shared admin components + skeletons
│   └── [feature]/                # 35+ feature directories
│
├── cms/                          # CMS core types and data
│   └── core/                     # cms-types.ts, hero-slides.ts, section-registry.ts
│
├── hooks/                        # 11 global hooks
├── lib/                          # Shared libraries (API, media, utils, etc.)
├── stores/                       # Global Zustand stores (auth)
├── styles/                       # globals.css (design tokens + component classes)
└── types/                        # TypeScript type definitions
```

### 8.2.2 Entry Point Chain

```
index.html
  └── src/app/main.tsx
        ├── StrictMode
        ├── HelmetProvider (react-helmet-async)
        ├── ConnectivityProvider (offline detection)
        └── App.tsx
              ├── QueryClientProvider (TanStack React Query)
              ├── BrowserRouter
              ├── Suspense (LoadingFallback)
              ├── ErrorBoundary
              ├── Toaster (Toast context)
              ├── Routes
              │   ├── STOREFRONT_ROUTES (wrapped in StorefrontLayout)
              │   ├── AUTH_ROUTES (unwrapped)
              │   ├── ADMIN_ROUTES (wrapped in AdminRoute + AdminRoutes)
              │   └── * → NotFoundPage
              ├── AuthLoader
              ├── GoogleAnalytics
              ├── CookieConsent
              └── PwaInstallPrompt
```

### 8.2.3 Architecture Decisions

| Decision | Choice | Rationale |
|----------|--------|-----------|
| Framework | React SPA (not Next.js) | Vite + react-router-dom for client-side routing |
| Code Organization | Feature-based | `storefront/`, `admin/`, `pages/`, `components/` separation |
| State Management | Zustand | 4 stores: auth, cart, UI, connectivity |
| Server State | TanStack React Query | Caching, refetching, optimistic updates |
| Code Splitting | React.lazy() | All page-level components lazy-loaded |
| Admin Loading | lazyWithRetry | Retry mechanism for admin chunks |
| Theming | CMS-driven CSS custom properties | Dynamic brand colors/fonts from backend |
| Security | httpOnly cookies | No localStorage for auth tokens |
| Cart Persistence | Zustand persist + per-user isolation | Guest vs authenticated cart separation |
| Accessibility | Built-in | Focus traps, keyboard nav, ARIA, skip links |
| Mobile | Bottom nav + safe areas + haptics | Native-feel mobile experience |
| Offline | Service worker + connectivity queue | PWA with offline support |
| Bilingual | Noto Serif Bengali font | Bengali + English typography support |

| `scale-in` | 0.4s | opacity 0→1, scale 0.95→1 | Modal entrance |
| `gold-pulse` | 2s infinite | opacity 1→0.6→1 | Gold accent pulse |
| `shimmer` | 2s infinite | backgroundPosition -200%→200% | Loading shimmer |
| `float-slow` | 6s infinite | translateY 0→-8px→0 | Floating elements |
| `image-reveal` | 1.2s | clipPath inset(0 100% 0 0)→inset(0) | Image reveal |

## 8.4 Layout System

### 8.4.1 StorefrontLayout (`src/storefront/layout/Layout.tsx`)

**Purpose:** Root layout for all customer-facing pages.

**Structure:**
```
StorefrontLayout
├── ScrollToTopOnNavigate (scroll to top on route change)
├── Helmet (SEO meta, structured data, custom CSS, analytics)
├── Header (fixed, dual-bar desktop / single-bar mobile)
├── MobileNav (drawer navigation)
├── SearchOverlay (full-screen search)
├── CartDrawer (slide-in cart)
├── Skip to Content link (accessibility)
├── <main> (flex-1, padded for header + bottom nav)
│   ├── ErrorBoundary
│   └── AnimatePresence (page transitions)
│       └── motion.div (fade + slide animation)
│           └── <Outlet /> (child routes)
├── SocialProof (social proof notifications)
├── BottomNav (mobile bottom navigation)
├── ScrollToTop (floating button)
└── Footer (full footer with newsletter)
```

**Key Features:**
- CMS-driven dynamic theming (CSS custom properties from backend)
- `useReducedMotion()` respects user preference
- `AnimatePresence` with `mode="wait"` for page transitions
- Checkout route hides SocialProof and BottomNav
- Header height dynamically measured (64px mobile, 112px desktop)
- Skip-to-content link for keyboard navigation
- Custom CSS injection from CMS settings
- Facebook Pixel + Google Tag Manager integration

### 8.4.2 Header (`src/storefront/layout/Header.tsx`)

**Purpose:** Dual-bar desktop header / single-bar mobile header.

**Desktop Structure:**
```
Header (fixed, z-50)
├── Announcement Bar (optional, CMS-driven)
├── Upper Bar (hidden on mobile)
│   ├── Brand flip animation (text ↔ logo toggle every 4s)
│   └── Utility icons (Search, Wishlist, Notifications, Account, Admin, Cart)
└── Lower Bar
    ├── Navigation links (CMS-driven, mega menu support)
    └── Mega Menu (AnimatePresence, hover-triggered)
```

**Mobile Structure:**
```
Header (fixed, z-50)
├── Hamburger menu button
├── Logo (mobile-specific or fallback to desktop)
└── Search + Cart icons
```

**Behaviors:**
- Auto-hide on scroll down, reveal on scroll up (mobile only)
- Scroll-based background: transparent → `bg-white/95` with `backdrop-blur-heavy`
- Brand flip animation cycles between text and logo every 4 seconds
- Mega menu opens on hover with 150ms close delay
- Notification badge shows unread count (polled every 2 min)
- Cart badge shows item count with scale animation on change
- Theme-configurable: hide search, wishlist, account, cart, announcement bar

### 8.4.3 Footer (`src/storefront/layout/Footer.tsx`)

**Purpose:** Site-wide footer with newsletter, links, and social icons.

**Structure:**
```
Footer (bg-luxe-charcoal)
├── Newsletter Bar (optional, CMS-driven)
│   ├── Title + Subtitle
│   └── NewsletterForm (inline layout)
├── Main Footer
│   ├── Brand Column (name, tagline, social icons)
│   ├── Link Columns (CMS-driven, 4-column grid)
│   └── Contact Column
└── Bottom Bar
    ├── Copyright
    ├── Policy Links (CMS-driven)
    └── Back to Top button
```

### 8.4.4 BottomNav (`src/storefront/layout/BottomNav.tsx`)

**Purpose:** Mobile bottom navigation bar (5 items).

**Items:**
| Icon | Label | Route | Auth Required |
|------|-------|-------|---------------|
| Home | Home | `/` | No |
| Search | Browse | `/products` | No |
| Heart | Wishlist | `/account/wishlist` | Yes |
| ShoppingBag | Cart | `/cart` | No |
| User | Account | `/account` | Yes |

**Features:**
- Fixed bottom, z-40
- Backdrop blur + white/90 bg
- Active indicator: top bar + bold text
- Cart badge with count
- Haptic feedback on tap
- Safe area padding for notched devices
- Auth-gated routes redirect to login

### 8.4.5 MobileNav (`src/storefront/layout/MobileNav.tsx`)

**Purpose:** Full-screen mobile navigation drawer.

### 8.4.6 MegaMenu (`src/storefront/layout/MegaMenu.tsx`)

**Purpose:** Desktop mega menu with multiple layout variants.

**Layout Types:**
1. **Promotional** — 2-column: image + content
2. **Mega Menu** — 4-column grid + optional featured image
3. **Children** — Multi-column links + optional banner

### 8.4.7 SearchOverlay (`src/storefront/layout/SearchOverlay.tsx`)

**Purpose:** Full-screen search overlay with instant results.

**Features:**
- Focus trap for accessibility
- 300ms debounced search
- Autocomplete suggestions (min 2 chars)
- Trending searches
- Recent searches (per-user, localStorage)
- Category matching
- Product grid results (4-column desktop, 2-column mobile)
- Body scroll lock when open

### 8.4.8 CartDrawer (`src/storefront/components/CartDrawer.tsx`)

**Purpose:** Slide-in cart panel.

**Features:**
- Spring animation (damping: 30, stiffness: 300)
- Backdrop blur overlay
- Body scroll lock
- Quantity controls (+/-)
- Free shipping threshold calculation
- Tax calculation
- Coupon discount display
- Empty state with CTA
- Out-of-stock warnings
- "Proceed to Checkout" + "View Full Bag" actions

### 8.4.9 AdminLayout (`src/admin/layout/AdminLayout.tsx`)

**Purpose:** Admin panel shell with sidebar + top bar.

**Structure:**
```
AdminLayout
├── Sidebar (fixed, z-50, dark bg)
│   ├── Brand name + Admin badge
│   ├── Navigation items (expandable groups)
│   └── Scroll position persistence
├── Mobile overlay (backdrop)
├── Header (sticky, z-30)
│   ├── Hamburger (mobile)
│   ├── User name + role
│   ├── View Site link
│   └── Sign Out button
└── Main content area (Outlet)
```

**Navigation Items (35+):**
- Dashboard
- Products (All Products, Brands, Size Guides, Labels & Tags)
- Inventory
- Categories
- Collections
- Orders
- Returns & Refunds
- Customers
- Content (CMS, Homepage Builder, Hero Slides, Footer Builder, Header Builder)
- Lookbooks
- Media Library
- Coupons
- Announcements
- Reviews
- SEO
- Search Index
- Import / Export
- Support (Tickets, FAQ)
- Management (Newsletter, Contact Submissions, Social Links, Notifications)
- Webhooks
- Page Templates
- Theme (Theme Builder)
- Abandoned Carts
- Campaigns
- System (Audit Log, Auth Activity)
- Wishlists
- Analytics
- Settings

**Features:**
- Expandable/collapsible sidebar groups (persisted to localStorage)
- Scroll position persistence
- Auto-expand parent when child is active
- Escape key closes mobile sidebar
- Segment-aware active matching
- `noindex, nofollow` meta tag

## 8.8 State Management

### 8.8.1 Zustand Stores

#### Auth Store (`src/stores/auth-store.ts`)

| State | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `user` | `UserProfile \| null` | Current user profile |
| `isAuthenticated` | `boolean` | Auth status |
| `isAdmin` | `boolean` | Admin role check |
| `isLoading` | `boolean` | Initial auth check loading |

| Action | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `setAuth(user)` | Set authenticated user |
| `setUser(user)` | Update user data |
| `setLoading(loading)` | Set loading state |
| `clearAuth()` | Clear auth state (logout) |

**Security:** No localStorage persistence. Tokens stored in httpOnly cookies only.

#### Cart Store (`src/storefront/stores/cart-store.ts`)

| State | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `items` | `CartItem[]` | Cart items |
| `couponCode` | `string \| null` | Applied coupon |
| `discount` | `number` | Discount amount |
| `discountType` | `"percentage" \| "fixed" \| null` | Discount type |
| `justAdded` | `string \| null` | Last added variant ID |

| Action | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `addItem(item)` | Add item (merges if exists) |
| `removeItem(variantId)` | Remove item |
| `updateQuantity(variantId, qty)` | Update quantity |
| `clearCart()` | Clear all items |
| `applyCoupon(code, discount, type)` | Apply coupon |
| `removeCoupon()` | Remove coupon |
| `switchUser()` | Switch cart on auth change |
| `applyServerCart(payload)` | Hydrate from server |

| Getter | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `itemCount()` | Total item count |
| `subtotal()` | Subtotal before discount |
| `discountAmount()` | Calculated discount |
| `total()` | Final total |

**Persistence:** Zustand `persist` middleware with per-user localStorage isolation.

#### UI Store (`src/storefront/stores/ui-store.ts`)

| State | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `isMobileMenuOpen` | `boolean` | Mobile menu state |
| `isSearchOpen` | `boolean` | Search overlay state |
| `isCartOpen` | `boolean` | Cart drawer state |
| `isWishlistOpen` | `boolean` | Wishlist drawer state |
| `activeMegaMenu` | `string \| null` | Active mega menu label |

| Action | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `toggleMobileMenu()` | Toggle mobile menu |
| `closeMobileMenu()` | Close mobile menu |
| `openSearch()` | Open search, close mega menu |
| `closeSearch()` | Close search |
| `openCart()` | Open cart drawer |
| `closeCart()` | Close cart drawer |
| `openWishlist()` | Open wishlist |
| `closeWishlist()` | Close wishlist |
| `setActiveMegaMenu(label)` | Set active mega menu |

#### Connectivity Store (`src/storefront/store/connectivity-store.ts`)

| State | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|

### 8.8.2 React Query Configuration

```typescript
const queryClient = new QueryClient({
  defaultOptions: {
    queries: {
      staleTime: 1000 * 60 * 5,    // 5 minutes
      retry: 1,                     // Single retry
      refetchOnWindowFocus: false,  // No refocus refetch
    },
  },
});
```

### 8.8.3 Toast Context

- `Toaster` component wraps the app
- `useToast()` hook provides `toast(message, type)` function
- Toasts auto-dismiss after 4 seconds
- Three types: `success`, `error`, `info`

### 8.8.4 Connectivity Context

- `ConnectivityProvider` wraps the app in `main.tsx`
- `useConnectivityManager()` hook tracks online/offline status
- Queues operations when offline
- Shows `OfflineIndicator` and `EmergencyModeIndicator` components

## 8.9 Navigation & Routing

### 8.9.1 Route Structure

```
/                              → HomePage
/products                      → ProductListingPage
/products/:slug                → ProductDetailPage
/search                        → SearchResultsPage
/cart                          → CartPage
/wishlist                      → WishlistPage
/collections                   → CollectionsIndexPage
/collections/:slug             → CollectionPage
/categories/:slug              → CategoryPage
/checkout                      → CheckoutPage
/lookbooks                     → LookbookPage
/lookbooks/:slug               → LookbookDetailPage
/faq                           → FaqPage
/privacy                       → StaticPage
/terms                         → StaticPage
/shipping-returns              → StaticPage
/:slug                         → StaticPage (CMS pages)

/auth/login                    → LoginPage
/auth/register                 → RegisterPage
/auth/forgot-password          → ForgotPasswordPage
/auth/reset-password           → ResetPasswordPage
/auth/verify-email             → VerifyEmailPage

/account                       → DashboardPage [Protected]
/account/orders                → OrdersPage [Protected]
/account/orders/:id            → OrderDetailPage [Protected]
/account/orders/:id/return     → ReturnRequestPage [Protected]
/account/orders/:id/tracking   → OrderTrackingPage [Protected]
/account/addresses             → AddressesPage [Protected]
/account/wishlist              → WishlistPage [Protected]
/account/notifications         → NotificationsPage [Protected]
/account/settings              → SettingsPage [Protected]
/account/support               → SupportTicketsPage [Protected]

/admin/*                       → AdminRoutes [AdminRoute]
```

### 8.9.2 Route Guards

| Guard | File | Behavior |
|-------|------|----------|
| `ProtectedRoute` | `components/auth/ProtectedRoute.tsx` | Redirects to `/auth/login` if not authenticated. Stores `from` location in state. |
| `AdminRoute` | `components/auth/AdminRoute.tsx` | Redirects non-admin users. Wraps `ProtectedRoute`. |

### 8.9.3 Code Splitting

| Mechanism | Usage |
|-----------|-------|
| `React.lazy()` | All storefront and auth pages |
| `lazyWithRetry()` | All admin pages (retry on chunk load failure) |
| `Suspense` | Wraps all lazy-loaded routes |
| `ErrorBoundary` | Wraps each route for error isolation |

### 8.9.4 Scroll Behavior

- `ScrollToTopOnNavigate` component scrolls to top on route change
- `ScrollToTop` floating button for manual scroll to top
- `scroll-behavior: smooth` on `<html>` element

## 8.10 Responsive System

### 8.10.1 Breakpoints

| Breakpoint | Width | Layout |
|------------|-------|--------|
| Mobile | < 768px | Single column, bottom nav, mobile header |
| Tablet | 768px+ | 2-column grids, desktop header |
| Desktop | 1024px+ | Full layout, sidebar, mega menu |
| Large | 1280px+ | Wider containers |
| Ultra Wide | 1600px+ | Max container width |

### 8.10.2 Responsive Behaviors

| Element | Mobile | Desktop |
|---------|--------|---------|
| Header | Hamburger + logo + search/cart | Dual bar (brand + nav + utilities) |
| Navigation | BottomNav (5 items) + MobileNav drawer | Header nav links + MegaMenu |
| Product Grid | 2 columns | 3-4 columns |
| Product Card | Full-width cards, add-to-cart button | Aspect-ratio cards, hover effects |
| Cart | Full-screen drawer | Slide-in drawer (480px max) |
| Search | Full-screen overlay | Full-screen overlay |
| Footer | Single column, stacked | 6-column grid |
| Admin Sidebar | Slide-in overlay | Fixed sidebar |
| Buttons | Full-width | Auto-width |
| Section Spacing | py-12 | py-24 to py-32 |

### 8.10.3 Mobile-First Utilities

| Utility | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `.pb-safe` | Safe area bottom padding |
| `.pb-safe-top` | Safe area top padding |
| `.pt-safe` | Safe area top padding |
| `.pb-safe-bottom` | Safe area bottom padding |
| `.pl-safe` / `.pr-safe` | Safe area left/right padding |
| `.pb-bottom-nav` | Bottom nav safe padding |
| `.touch-manipulation` | Disable 300ms tap delay |
| `.no-tap-highlight` | Remove tap highlight |
| `.momentum-scroll` | iOS momentum scrolling |
| `.hide-scrollbar` | Hide scrollbars |
| `.scroll-snap-x` | Horizontal scroll snap |
| `.overscroll-contain` | Prevent overscroll |
| `.gpu-accelerate` | GPU acceleration |
| `.fixed-gpu` | Fixed position GPU fix |

### 8.10.4 Touch Targets

All interactive elements maintain minimum 44x44px touch targets:
- Bottom nav items: `min-w-[48px]`
- Cart quantity buttons: `min-w-[44px] h-11`
- Header icons: `p-2.5` (40px) with 44px+ effective area
- Mobile wishlist button: `w-10 h-10` (40px)

## 8.11 Animation System

### 8.11.1 Page Transitions

```tsx
// StorefrontLayout.tsx
<AnimatePresence mode="wait">
  <motion.div
    key={pathname}
    initial={prefersReducedMotion ? undefined : { opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
    animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
    exit={prefersReducedMotion ? undefined : { opacity: 0, y: -20 }}
    transition={{ duration: 0.3, ease: "easeOut" }}
  >
    <Outlet />
  </motion.div>
</AnimatePresence>
```

### 8.11.2 Component Animations

| Component | Animation | Trigger |
|-----------|-----------|---------|
| Header brand | Fade + slide Y (text ↔ logo) | 4s interval |
| Mega Menu | Fade + slide Y (-4px) | Hover enter/leave |
| Cart Drawer | Slide X (100% → 0) + spring | Open/close |
| Search Overlay | Fade in/out | Open/close |
| Product Card | Fade in (opacity) | Viewport entry |
| Wishlist Heart | Scale 0 → 1 | Toggle |
| Cart Badge | Scale 0.5 → 1 | Item count change |
| Toast | Slide up | Appear |
| Bottom Nav | Active bar slide | Route change |

### 8.11.3 Reduced Motion

- `useReducedMotion()` from framer-motion used in all animated components
- When true: animations use `undefined` initial state (no animation)
- `scroll-behavior: smooth` disabled by OS preference
- All keyframe animations still available via CSS classes

### 8.11.4 Desktop Premium Overrides

```css
@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .premium-card.product-card {
    backdrop-blur-sm;
    bg-white/80;
  }
  .premium-card.product-card:hover {
    shadow-elevated;
    border-neutral-200/60;
  }
  .btn-primary { px-10 py-3.5; tracking-[0.2em]; }
  .section-padding { py-24 lg:py-32; }
  .container-wide { max-w-[1600px]; }
}
```
