## 8.13 Accessibility

### 8.13.1 WCAG Compliance

| Feature | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| Skip to Content | `<a href="#main-content" className="sr-only focus:not-sr-only">` |
| Focus Ring | `*:focus-visible { ring-2 ring-brand-500/40 ring-offset-2 }` |
| ARIA Labels | All interactive elements have `aria-label` |
| ARIA Live | Toast container has `aria-live="assertive"` |
| ARIA Expanded | Mega menu triggers have `aria-expanded` |
| ARIA Current | Active nav items have `aria-current="page"` |
| ARIA Modal | Cart drawer, search overlay, modals have `role="dialog"` and `aria-modal="true"` |
| ARIA Busy | Loading buttons have `aria-busy` |
| ARIA Invalid | Error inputs have `aria-invalid` |
| Screen Reader | Icons have `aria-hidden="true"` |
| Loading States | Skeleton components have `role="status"` and `aria-label="Loading"` |
| Reduced Motion | `useReducedMotion()` from framer-motion |

### 8.13.2 Keyboard Navigation

- `useFocusTrap` hook for modals and overlays
- `useKeyboardNavigation` hook for list navigation
- Tab order follows logical flow
- Escape key closes overlays (search, cart, mobile nav)
- Arrow keys navigate mega menu items

### 8.13.3 Semantic HTML

- `<header>`, `<main>`, `<footer>`, `<nav>` elements
- `<h1>` through `<h5>` heading hierarchy
- `<Link>` components for navigation
- `<button>` for actions
- `<label>` for form inputs

## 8.14 Performance

### 8.14.1 Code Splitting

| Mechanism | Usage |
|-----------|-------|
| Route-based splitting | Every page lazy-loaded |
| Admin chunk filtering | `filterAdminPreload()` Vite plugin removes admin chunk preloads |
| Dynamic imports | All page components use `React.lazy()` |

### 8.14.2 Build Configuration

| Setting | Value |
|---------|-------|
| Target | ES2020 |
| CSS Minifier | LightningCSS |
| JS Minifier | esbuild |
| Source Maps | Disabled |
| Assets Inline Limit | 4096 bytes |
| Chunk Size Warning | 500 KB |

### 8.14.3 Image Optimization

- `SafeImage` component with lazy loading
- `content-visibility: auto` on lazy images
- Responsive images via `srcset`
- Cloudinary for image optimization
- Video support with `playsInline` and `muted` attributes

### 8.14.4 Font Optimization

- Google Fonts preconnect in `index.html`
- `font-display: swap` (via Google Fonts URL)
- Font loading: Manrope (200-800), Cormorant Garamond (300-700), Noto Serif Bengali (300-700)

### 8.14.5 Caching

- React Query `staleTime: 5 minutes`
- `retry: 1` for failed queries
- `refetchOnWindowFocus: false`
- Service worker for offline caching
- Zustand persist for cart (localStorage)

### 8.14.6 Bundle Analysis

- Admin chunks filtered from preload (custom Vite plugin)
- React ecosystem not manually split (avoids React 19 initialization order issues)
- Rollup determines chunking automatically

## 8.24 Risk Matrix

### Critical Risks

| Risk | Impact | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|------|--------|------------|------------|
| React 19 chunk splitting crash | App fails to load | Medium | No manual vendor splitting; Rollup handles chunking |
| Auth token exposure | Security breach | Low | httpOnly cookies only; no localStorage for tokens |
| Cart data loss | User frustration | Low | Zustand persist with per-user isolation |

### High Risks

| Risk | Impact | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|------|--------|------------|------------|
| Admin chunk load failure | Admin inaccessible | Medium | `lazyWithRetry()` with 1s retry |
| Service worker failure | No offline support | Low | App works without service worker |
| CMS theme injection | CSS injection | Low | CSS custom properties only; no arbitrary CSS |

### Medium Risks

| Risk | Impact | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|------|--------|------------|------------|
| Bundle size growth | Slow initial load | Medium | Code splitting, lazy loading, chunk size warning |
| Font loading flash | Layout shift | Medium | `font-display: swap` via Google Fonts |
| Mobile iOS zoom on input | Poor UX | Low | `font-size: max(16px, 1rem)` on all inputs |

### Low Risks

| Risk | Impact | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|------|--------|------------|------------|
| localStorage quota | Cart persistence fails | Low | Try/catch around localStorage |
| Service worker update | Stale content | Low | Auto-update on page reload |
| Haptic feedback failure | No tactile feedback | Low | Graceful degradation |

# PHASE 09 — MEDIA LIBRARY, CLOUDINARY, ASSET MANAGEMENT & STORAGE ARCHITECTURE

> **Generated:** 2026-07-13
> **Version:** 9.0.0
> **Live Site:** [https://www.nabome.online](https://www.nabome.online)
> **Cloudinary Cloud:** `dmzbh87bi`
> **Mode:** READ ONLY — Documentation Only

---

## 9.0 Executive Summary

NABOME's media architecture is built entirely on **Cloudinary** as the CDN, image processing, and asset management backbone. There is **no direct object storage** (no S3, no R2, no local filesystem) — every binary asset passes through Cloudinary's signed upload API and is served from Cloudinary's global CDN.

### Architecture Principles

| Principle | Implementation |
|-----------|---------------|
| Single Source of Truth | PostgreSQL `media_assets` table + Cloudinary as delivery layer |
| Dual-Column Pattern | Every entity stores both `url` and `publicId` for Cloudinary management |
| Signed API Access | All Cloudinary API calls use HMAC-SHA1 signatures |
| Polymorphic Association | `media_assets` links to any entity via `entityType` + `entityId` |
| Soft Delete + Trash | Two-phase deletion: trash → permanent delete |
| Usage Protection | Assets referenced by entities cannot be deleted |
| Audit Trail | Every mutation logged to `media_audit_logs` |
| Integrity Monitoring | Drift detection between DB and Cloudinary state |
| Auto-Optimization | `f_auto` (format) + `q_auto:best` (quality) on every delivery |
| Retina Support | `dpr_2.0` applied to all Cloudinary transformations |

### Key Metrics

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Total Media Files (estimated) | 500+ |
| Cloudinary Cloud Name | `dmzbh87bi` |
| Root Folder | `nabome` |
| Entity Types Tracked | 13 |
| Database Tables with Media Fields | 14 |
| Media API Endpoints | 18 |
| Backend Media Service Files | 17 |
| Frontend Media Service Files | 18 |
| Frontend Media Components | 15+ |
| Supported Image Formats | 7 (JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP, TIFF) |
| Supported Video Formats | 4 (MP4, WebM, QuickTime, AVI) |
| Supported Document Formats | 1 (PDF) |
| Max Image Size | 10MB |
| Max Video Size | 100MB |
| Max Document Size | 5MB |
| Max Batch Upload | 10 files |
| Max Images Per Entity | 20 |
| Max Videos Per Entity | 5 |

## 9.1 Storage Architecture

### 9.1.1 Architecture Overview

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                         NABOME MEDIA ARCHITECTURE                │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                  │
│  ┌──────────┐    ┌──────────────┐    ┌────────────────────┐     │
│  │  Admin /  │───>│  API Handler  │───>│  Validation Layer  │     │
│  │  Customer │    │  (Cloudflare  │    │  - MIME type       │     │
│  │  Browser  │    │   Workers)    │    │  - Magic bytes     │     │
│  └──────────┘    └──────────────┘    │  - File size        │     │
│                                       │  - Extension check  │     │
│                                       └────────┬───────────┘     │
│                                                │                  │
│                                       ┌────────▼───────────┐     │
│                                       │  Cloudinary Upload  │     │
│                                       │  (Signed API)       │     │
│                                       │  POST /auto/upload  │     │
│                                       └────────┬───────────┘     │
│                                                │                  │
│                              ┌─────────────────┼──────────────┐  │
│                              │                 │              │  │
│                    ┌─────────▼───┐    ┌────────▼─────┐       │  │
│                    │  PostgreSQL  │    │  Cloudinary   │       │  │
│                    │  media_assets│    │  CDN + Storage │       │  │
│                    │  (metadata)  │    │  (binaries)    │       │  │
│                    └─────────┬───┘    └────────┬─────┘       │  │
│                              │                 │              │  │
│                              └────────┬────────┘              │  │
│                                       │                       │  │
│                              ┌────────▼───────────┐           │  │
│                              │  Cloudflare CDN     │           │  │
│                              │  (edge caching)     │           │  │
│                              └────────┬───────────┘           │  │
│                                       │                       │  │
│                              ┌────────▼───────────┐           │  │
│                              │  Storefront / Admin  │          │  │
│                              │  (React + Vite)      │          │  │
│                              └────────────────────┘           │  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 9.1.2 Storage Layers

| Layer | Technology | Purpose | TTL |
|-------|-----------|---------|-----|
| **Origin Storage** | Cloudinary | Binary asset storage | Permanent |
| **Metadata Storage** | PostgreSQL (Supabase) | Asset metadata, relationships, audit | Permanent |
| **Edge Cache** | Cloudflare CDN | Static asset delivery | Immutable (1 year) |
| **Cloudinary CDN** | Cloudinary | Image/video delivery with transforms | Configurable |
| **Browser Cache** | Service Worker | Offline-first image caching | Cache-first strategy |
| **Usage Cache** | DB columns (`usageCache`) | Cross-table reference checks | 5 minutes |

### 9.1.3 No Local Filesystem

The codebase contains **zero** local file storage operations. All uploads are streamed directly from the browser to Cloudinary via the API. The Cloudflare Workers API acts as a signing proxy — it never touches the binary file content.

### 9.1.4 Environment Configuration

```
# Frontend (browser-exposed via VITE_)
VITE_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME=dmzbh87bi
VITE_CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_PRESET=<unsigned_preset>

# Backend (server-only, NEVER exposed)
CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME=dmzbh87bi
CLOUDINARY_API_KEY=<api_key>
CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET=<api_secret>
CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_PRESET=<signed_preset>
```

## 9.2 Cloudinary Architecture

### 9.1.1 Cloudinary Configuration

**Config File:** `src/lib/media/cloudinary.config.ts` (227 lines)

```typescript
DEFAULT_UPLOAD_OPTIONS = {
  overwrite: false,
  eager: "f_auto,q_auto",      // Auto format + auto quality on upload
  autoFormat: true,
  autoQuality: true
}

DEFAULT_DELIVERY_OPTIONS = {
  secureOnly: true,              // HTTPS only
  cdn: true                      // Cloudinary CDN enabled
}
```

**Cloud Name:** `dmzbh87bi` (hardcoded in `src/lib/seo.ts` as fallback)

### 9.1.2 API Endpoints Used

| Operation | Cloudinary Endpoint | Method | Auth |
|-----------|-------------------|--------|------|
| Upload | `v1_1/{cloud}/auto/upload` | POST | HMAC-SHA1 signed |
| Delete | `v1_1/{cloud}/{type}/destroy` | POST | HMAC-SHA1 signed |
| Copy | `v1_1/{cloud}/{type}/copy` | POST | HMAC-SHA1 signed |
| Rename/Move | `v1_1/{cloud}/{type}/rename` | POST | HMAC-SHA1 signed |
| List Folders | `v1_1/{cloud}/folders` | POST | HMAC-SHA1 signed |
| Search | `v1_1/{cloud}/resources/search` | POST | HMAC-SHA1 signed |
| Delete by Prefix | `v1_1/{cloud}/{type}/delete_by_prefix` | POST | HMAC-SHA1 signed |
| Get Asset | `v1_1/{cloud}/{type}/upload/{publicId}` | GET | HMAC-SHA1 signed |
| List Resources | `v1_1/{cloud}/resources/{type}` | GET | HMAC-SHA1 signed |
| Metadata | `v1_1/{cloud}/{type}/metadata` | POST | HMAC-SHA1 signed |
| Usage Stats | `v1_1/{cloud}/resources/usage` | GET | HMAC-SHA1 signed |

### 9.1.3 Signature Generation

All Cloudinary API calls use **HMAC-SHA1** signatures:

```typescript
// api/_lib/media/cloudinary.ts
function generateSignature(params: string, apiSecret: string): string {
  // Uses Web Crypto API: crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-1', ...)
  // Concatenates params + apiSecret, hashes, returns hex
}
```

### 9.1.4 Timeout Configuration

| Operation | Timeout | File Reference |
|-----------|---------|----------------|
| Upload | 30 seconds | `media.constants.ts` |
| Delete (Destroy) | 10 seconds | `media.constants.ts` |
| Folder Operations | 30 seconds | `media.constants.ts` |
| Asset Metadata | 10 seconds | `media.constants.ts` |

```
CloudinaryError (base)
├── UploadFailedError
├── DeleteFailedError
├── CopyFailedError
├── MoveFailedError
├── ReplaceFailedError
```


### 9.3.5 Slug Migration

When an entity slug changes, all its Cloudinary assets are migrated:

```typescript
// api/_lib/media/lifecycle.ts
async function migrateEntitySlug(entityType, oldSlug, newSlug) {
  // 1. List all resources under nabome/{entityType}/{oldSlug}
  // 2. For each resource: Cloudinary rename to nabome/{entityType}/{newSlug}/...
  // 3. Update DB records with new folder, publicId, url, secureUrl
}
```

### 9.4.3 File Type Validation

**Service:** `api/_lib/media/validation.ts` (163 lines) + `src/lib/media/media.constants.ts` (234 lines)

**Magic Byte Signatures Validated:**

| MIME | Signature Bytes | Description |
|------|----------------|-------------|
| `image/jpeg` | `FF D8 FF` | JPEG header |
| `image/png` | `89 50 4E 47` | PNG signature |
| `image/webp` | `52 49 46 46` + `57 45 42 50` | RIFF + WEBP |
| `image/avif` | `ftyp` at offset 4 | AVIF container |
| `image/gif` | `47 49 46 38` | GIF89a/GIF87a |
| `image/bmp` | `42 4D` | BMP header |
| `image/tiff` | `49 49 2A 00` or `4D 4D 00 2A` | TIFF LE/BE |
| `video/mp4` | `ftyp` at offset 4 | MP4 container |
| `video/webm` | `1A 45 DF A3` | WebM header |
| `video/quicktime` | `ftyp` at offset 4 | QuickTime/MOV |
| `video/x-msvideo` | `52 49 46 46` | AVI header |
| `application/pdf` | `25 50 44 46` | %PDF header |

**Dangerous Extension Blocklist** (`api/_lib/file-security.ts`):

```
.exe, .bat, .cmd, .sh, .ps1, .vbs, .js, .jar,
.php, .asp, .aspx, .jsp, .py, .rb, .pl, .cgi,
.dll, .so, .dylib, .app, .deb, .rpm, .msi
```

**Validation Flow:**
```
1. Check MIME type against allowed list
2. Read first 12 bytes of file content
3. Verify binary signature matches declared MIME
4. Check file size against type-specific limit
5. Validate extension matches MIME type
6. Sanitize filename (remove path traversal)
```

```
product_variants.videoPublicId

lookbooks.coverImagePublicId
```

## 9.6 Media Flow Diagrams

### 9.6.1 Upload Flow

```
┌──────────┐     ┌──────────┐     ┌──────────┐     ┌──────────┐
│  Select   │────>│ Validate  │────>│ Upload   │────>│  Create  │
│  File(s)  │     │ File      │     │ Cloudinary│    │  DB      │
└──────────┘     └──────────┘     └──────────┘     │  Record   │
                         │                          └──────────┘
                         │ Failure                        │
                         ▼                                │
                   ┌──────────┐                          │
                   │  Reject   │<─── Rollback ───────────┘
                   │  Upload   │     (if DB fails)
                   └──────────┘
```

**Detailed Upload Steps:**
1. Browser selects file(s) via `<input>` or drag-and-drop
2. Client-side validation: MIME type, file size, extension
3. `POST /api/upload` or `POST /api/admin/media/upload`
4. Rate limit check: 20 req/min per IP
5. `validateFile()` — MIME type check
6. `validateFileContent()` — Magic byte signature verification
7. `generateAssetId()` → `asset_` + 13-char UUID
8. `buildCloudinaryPublicId()` → `{folder}/{assetId}/{filename}`
9. `uploadToCloudinary()` — Signed POST to `/auto/upload`
10. `prisma.media_assets.create()` — Store metadata
11. If DB insert fails → `deleteAsset()` from Cloudinary (rollback)
12. Response with full media metadata

### 9.6.2 Soft Delete (Trash) Flow

```
┌──────────┐     ┌──────────┐     ┌──────────┐     ┌──────────┐
│  Request  │────>│  Check   │────>│  Check   │────>│  Soft    │
│  Delete   │     │  Exists  │     │  Usage   │     │  Delete  │
└──────────┘     └──────────┘     └──────────┘     └──────────┘
                         │              │                  │
                         │ Not Found    │ In Use           │
                         ▼              ▼                  ▼
                   ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐     ┌──────────┐
                   │  404     │  │  Refuse  │     │  Audit   │
                   │  Error   │  │  (409)   │     │  Log     │
                   └──────────┘  └──────────┘     └──────────┘
```

```
│  Force    │     │  Transact│     │  From    │     │  From    │
│  Delete   │     │          │     │  Cloud.  │     │  DB      │
└──────────┘     └──────────┘     └──────────┘     └──────────┘
```

## 9.7 Image Optimization

### 9.7.1 Cloudinary Transformations Applied

**Core Transformation Function:** `img()` in `src/lib/seo.ts` (257 lines)

```
Default:    q_auto:best,f_auto,dpr_2.0,c_limit
With width: q_auto:best,f_auto,dpr_2.0,c_limit,w_{width}
```

| Parameter | Value | Purpose |
|-----------|-------|---------|
| `q_auto:best` | Auto quality (best) | Cloudinary selects optimal quality |
| `f_auto` | Auto format | Serves WebP, AVIF, or JPEG based on browser |
| `dpr_2.0` | Device Pixel Ratio 2x | Retina display support |
| `c_limit` | Limit (no upscale) | Never upscales beyond original size |

### 9.7.2 Responsive Image Generation

**Function:** `imgSet()` in `src/lib/seo.ts`

```
Widths: [320, 640, 960, 1280, 1920]
Format: f_webp for all entries
Sizes: (max-width: 640px) 100vw, (max-width: 1024px) 50vw, (max-width: 1440px) 33vw, 25vw
```

### 9.7.3 Performance Module Presets

**File:** `src/lib/performance/optimizations.ts` (364 lines)

**Breakpoints:** `[320, 480, 640, 768, 1024, 1280, 1536, 1920]`

| Preset | Quality | Width | Height | Crop |
|--------|---------|-------|--------|------|
| Thumbnail | 75 | 200 | 200 | fill |
| Small | 75 | 400 | 400 | fill |
| Medium | 80 | 800 | 800 | fill |
| Large | 85 | 1200 | 1200 | fill |
| Hero | 85 | 1920 | 1080 | fill |
| Original | 90 | — | — | — |

**Quality Levels:** Low(60), Medium(75), High(85), Ultra(95)

### 9.7.4 Admin Media Library URL Generation

**File:** `src/admin/media/MediaLibraryNew.tsx` (lines 75-93)

Generates **12 URL variants** per asset for preview and link generation:

| Variant | Transformation | Purpose |
|---------|---------------|---------|
| `original` | — | Raw upload |
| `secure` | HTTPS | Secure delivery |
| `optimized` | `q_auto,f_auto` | Auto-optimized |
| `webp` | `f_webp` | WebP format |
| `avif` | `f_avif` | AVIF format |
| `autoFormat` | `f_auto` | Browser-negotiated |
| `autoQuality` | `q_auto` | Cloudinary-negotiated |
| `thumbnail` | `c_thumb,w_200,h_200,g_face` | Face-aware thumbnail |
| `small` | `c_scale,w_400` | 400px wide |
| `medium` | `c_scale,w_800` | 800px wide |
| `large` | `c_scale,w_1200` | 1200px wide |
| `blur` | `e_blur:1000` | Blurred placeholder |
| `grayscale` | `e_grayscale` | Grayscale filter |
| `responsive` | `f_auto,q_auto,w_auto,c_limit` | Fully responsive |

### 9.7.5 Lazy Loading Strategy

| Component | Strategy | Trigger |
|-----------|----------|---------|
| **SafeImage** (default) | `loading="lazy"` | Browser native |
| **SafeImage** (priority) | `loading="eager"` + `fetchPriority="high"` | Above fold |
| **IntersectionObserver** | Custom `LazyLoader` class | 50px root margin |
| **React.lazy()** | Route/section splitting | Code splitting |
| **Service Worker** | Cache-first for images | Offline support |

### 9.7.6 Blur Placeholder

Currently uses **pulse skeleton** (`animate-pulse` div) rather than Cloudinary blur. The `e_blur:1000` transformation exists in the link generator but is not wired as a placeholder in rendering components.

### 9.7.7 Double Extension Handling

**Function:** `stripDoubleExtension()` in `src/lib/seo.ts`

Cloudinary's `f_auto` breaks when the URL contains double extensions like `.jpeg.jpg`. The utility strips the trailing extension before applying Cloudinary transformations.

### 9.7.8 Unsplash Proxy

External Unsplash images are proxied through Cloudinary:

```
Original: https://images.unsplash.com/photo-xxx
Proxied:  https://res.cloudinary.com/dmzbh87bi/image/fetch/.../https://images.unsplash.com/photo-xxx
```

## 9.8 Video Management

### 9.8.1 Video Upload

- **Max Size:** 100MB
- **Allowed Formats:** MP4, WebM, QuickTime (MOV), AVI
- **Cloudinary Resource Type:** `video`
- **Upload Endpoint:** `POST /api/upload` (same as images)
- **Magic Byte Validation:** Yes (ftyp at offset 4 for MP4/MOV, `1A 45 DF A3` for WebM)

### 9.8.2 Video Delivery

- **Streaming:** Cloudinary CDN serves video directly
- **Format:** Auto-negotiated via `f_auto` (Cloudinary converts to MP4/WebM)
- **Lazy Loading:** Videos in gallery use `preload="metadata"` for non-primary, `preload="auto"` for first slide

### 9.8.3 Video Components

| Component | Usage | Features |
|-----------|-------|----------|
| `HeroCarousel` | Homepage hero | Auto-play, loop, muted, sound toggle, pause/play |
| `VideoBannerSection` | CMS section | Auto-play, loop, muted, poster fallback |
| `ImageGallery` | Product detail | Inline video with controls, poster from first image |
| `MediaManager` | Admin product | Upload, preview, set primary |

### 9.8.4 Video Thumbnails

Cloudinary auto-generates thumbnails for video resources. No custom thumbnail generation exists.

### 9.8.5 Video Caching

- **Service Worker:** Cache-first strategy for video assets
- **Cloudflare CDN:** Video assets served from edge
- **Browser:** Native video caching via `Cache-Control` headers

---

## 9.9 CDN & Caching

### 9.9.1 Cloudinary CDN

- **URL Pattern:** `https://res.cloudinary.com/dmzbh87bi/`
- **Auto Format:** `f_auto` — Cloudinary serves optimal format per browser
- **Secure URLs:** All URLs use HTTPS (`secureOnly: true`)
- **Edge Locations:** Cloudinary's global CDN (200+ PoPs)

### 9.9.2 Cloudflare CDN (Static Assets)

**File:** `functions/_middleware.ts` + `api/[...path].ts`

| Asset Type | Cache-Control | CDN-Cache-Control |
|-----------|---------------|-------------------|
| `/assets/*.js` | `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` | — |
| `/assets/*.css` | `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` | — |
| `/images/*` | `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` | — |
| `/favicon*` | `public, max-age=86400, stale-while-revalidate=604800` | — |
| `/index.html` | `public, max-age=0, must-revalidate` | — |
| `/api/*` | `no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate` | `no-store` |

### 9.9.3 Content-Based Caching (Dynamic)

| Content Type | Cache-Control | SWR |
|-------------|---------------|-----|
| Products/Categories/Collections | `max-age=60` | `stale-while-revalidate=300` |
| CMS/Settings | `max-age=300` | `stale-while-revalidate=600` |
| Admin/Auth/Checkout | `no-store, no-cache` | — |

### 9.9.4 Service Worker Cache

**File:** `public/sw.js` (115 lines)

- **Cache Version:** `nabome-v6`
- **Image Strategy:** Cache-first with fallback to transparent SVG
- **JS/CSS/Fonts:** Stale-while-revalidate
- **Navigation:** Network-first with cache fallback
- **Failed Images:** Returns transparent SVG (prevents console errors)

### 9.9.5 Usage Cache

**File:** `api/_lib/media/usage-cache.service.ts` (251 lines)

- **Storage:** DB columns `usageCache`, `usageCacheValid`, `usageCacheAt`
- **TTL:** 5 minutes
- **Invalidation:** On soft delete, restore, permanent delete, entity updates
- **Monitoring:** `getCacheStatistics()` for cache hit rates

### 9.9.6 Cache Busting

- **Static Assets:** Content-hashed filenames (`index-CWHRe8jL.js`)
- **Cloudinary URLs:** Version parameter available but not actively used
- **Service Worker:** Version-based cache invalidation (`nabome-v6`)
- **API Responses:** `no-cache` headers ensure fresh data

### 9.10.2 Rate Limiting

| Endpoint | Limit | Window | Key |
|----------|-------|--------|-----|
| Upload endpoints | 20 requests | 60 seconds | `{ip}:{endpoint}` |
| Admin endpoints | 60 requests | 60 seconds | `{userId}:{endpoint}` |
| Standard API | 30 requests | 10 seconds | `{ip}:{endpoint}` |
| Auth endpoints | 5 requests | 60 seconds | `{ip}:{endpoint}` |

**Storage:** Cloudflare KV (production) with in-memory fallback.

### 9.10.3 Request/Response Format

**Upload Request:**
```
Content-Type: multipart/form-data

Fields:
- file: File (required)
- entityType: string (optional)
- entityId: string (optional)
- slug: string (optional)
- altText: string (optional)
- displayName: string (optional)
- sortOrder: number (optional)
- isPrimary: boolean (optional)
- folder: string (optional, default: "media-library")
- tags: JSON string array (optional)
```

**Upload Response (201):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Media asset uploaded successfully",
  "media": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "assetId": "asset_ABC123",
    "url": "https://res.cloudinary.com/dmzbh87bi/image/upload/...",
    "secureUrl": "https://res.cloudinary.com/dmzbh87bi/image/upload/...",
    "publicId": "nabome/products/silk-kurti/asset_ABC123/photo.jpg",
    "folder": "nabome/products/silk-kurti",
    "resourceType": "image",
    "mimeType": "image/jpeg",
    "fileExtension": "jpg",
    "width": 1200,
    "height": 1600,
    "fileSize": 245000,
    "mediaType": "image",
    "altText": "...",
    "displayName": "...",
    "entityType": "products",
    "entityId": "product-uuid"
  }
}
```

## 9.11 Media Security

### 9.11.1 Authentication & Authorization

| Requirement | Implementation |
|------------|---------------|
| JWT Authentication | All media endpoints require valid JWT |
| Admin Role | Admin-only endpoints require `role === "admin"` |
| CSRF Protection | State-changing routes require CSRF token |
| Rate Limiting | Per-IP and per-user sliding window |

### 9.11.2 File Validation Security

| Check | Method | Purpose |
|-------|--------|---------|
| MIME Type | Content-Type header | Prevent type confusion |
| Magic Bytes | Binary signature (first 12 bytes) | Prevent spoofed uploads |
| Extension Blocklist | Dangerous extension check | Block executables/scripts |
| MIME-Extension Match | Cross-validation | Ensure declared type matches extension |
| File Size | Per-type limits | Prevent oversized uploads |
| Filename Sanitization | Path traversal removal | Prevent directory traversal |

### 9.11.3 Cloudinary Security

| Measure | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| Signed API Calls | HMAC-SHA1 for all mutations |
| API Secret | Server-only, never exposed to browser |
| Secure URLs | `secureOnly: true` — HTTPS only |
| Upload Preset | Signed preset (not unsigned) |
| Config Validation | Every operation validates credentials |

### 9.11.4 CSP Headers

```
img-src: 'self' data: blob: https://*.unsplash.com https://images.unsplash.com https://res.cloudinary.com
media-src: 'self' blob: https://res.cloudinary.com
connect-src: https://res.cloudinary.com
```

### 9.11.5 Delete Protection

Assets **cannot** be deleted if referenced by any entity. The usage check covers 14 tables before allowing deletion.

### 9.11.6 Audit Logging

Every destructive operation logs:
- `assetId` — Which asset
- `action` — What was done
- `performedBy` — Who did it (admin UUID)
- `ipAddress` — Source IP
- `userAgent` — Browser identifier
- `metadata` — Old/new values, reasons

### 9.11.7 Recovery

- **Soft Delete:** Assets in trash can be restored within retention period
- **Permanent Delete:** Uses Prisma transactions — if Cloudinary fails, DB record is preserved
- **Rollback:** If DB insert fails after Cloudinary upload, Cloudinary asset is cleaned up
- **Audit History:** Complete timeline of all operations per asset

---

## 9.12 Media Cleanup & Integrity

### 9.12.1 Integrity Service

**File:** `src/lib/media/integrity.service.ts` (911 lines)

**Scan Checks:**
- Missing assets (DB record exists but Cloudinary asset missing)
- Orphaned records (Cloudinary asset exists but no DB record)
- Incorrect folders (asset folder doesn't match entity)
- Duplicate assets (same filename/size in same folder)
- Metadata mismatches (width/height/fileSize differ between DB and Cloudinary)
- Invalid public IDs
- Broken references

### 9.12.2 Drift Detection

**File:** `api/_lib/media/drift-detection.service.ts` (265 lines)

- Compares all DB assets against Cloudinary state
- Detects: orphaned assets, missing assets, metadata mismatches
- **Scheduled:** Every 24 hours (configurable)
- **Repair:** Updates DB to match Cloudinary metadata

### 9.12.3 Orphan Cleanup

**File:** `api/_lib/media/background-cleanup.service.ts` (219 lines)

- Queue-based async cleanup for derived assets
- Rate limiting to prevent API abuse
- Priority-based: critical operations get immediate cleanup
- Bulk operations batch with per-asset error handling

### 9.12.4 Background Cleanup Service

```typescript
enqueueCleanup(assetId, type)     // Add to queue
immediateCleanup(assets)          // Synchronous for critical ops
bulkCleanup(assets, batchSize)    // Batch with rate limiting
```

### 9.12.5 Cleanup Scripts

| Script | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `scripts/cleanup-media.ts` | Remove orphaned assets |
| `scripts/verify-cloudinary.ts` | Verify Cloudinary state |
| `scripts/fix-broken-images.ts` | Repair broken image references |
| `scripts/reset-storage.ts` | Reset storage state (dangerous) |

### 9.12.6 Retention Policy

| State | Retention | Action |
|-------|-----------|--------|
| Active | Indefinite | No action |
| Trash (soft deleted) | Until manual permanent delete | Restorable |
| Permanent Deleted | Irrecoverable | Cloudinary + DB deleted |
| Orphaned (no DB record) | Cleaned by background job | Auto-deleted |

## 9.15 Performance Analysis

### 9.15.1 Image Loading Performance

| Technique | Impact | Implementation |
|-----------|--------|---------------|
| Auto Format (`f_auto`) | 40-60% size reduction | Cloudinary CDN |
| Auto Quality (`q_auto`) | 20-30% size reduction | Cloudinary CDN |
| Responsive Images | 50-70% bandwidth savings | `imgSet()` with srcSet |
| Lazy Loading | 30-50% initial load reduction | `loading="lazy"` |
| Preconnect | 100-300ms faster first image | `<link rel="preconnect">` |
| CDN | 50-200ms latency reduction | Cloudflare + Cloudinary |
| Service Worker | Instant repeat visits | Cache-first strategy |
| DPR 2.0 | Crisp retina without waste | `dpr_2.0` transform |

### 9.15.2 Bundle Size Considerations

| Module | Size | Purpose |
|--------|------|---------|
| `SafeImage` | ~3KB | Core image component |
| `ImageGallery` | ~8KB | Product gallery |
| `HeroCarousel` | ~6KB | Hero carousel |
| `MediaLibraryNew` | ~45KB | Admin media library |
| `seo.ts` (img/imgSet) | ~2KB | URL transformations |
| `performance/optimizations.ts` | ~8KB | Presets and utilities |
| Total media-related JS | ~72KB | All media functionality |

### 9.15.3 Bandwidth Optimization

| Strategy | Savings |
|----------|---------|
| Cloudinary auto-format | ~45% average |
| Cloudinary auto-quality | ~25% average |
| Responsive srcSet | ~60% for mobile |
| Lazy loading | ~40% initial load |
| Service Worker cache | ~90% repeat visits |
| **Total estimated savings** | **~70% vs unoptimized** |

### 9.15.4 Core Web Vitals Impact

| Metric | Media Impact | Mitigation |
|--------|-------------|------------|
| LCP | Hero image is often LCP | `priority` prop + preconnect |
| CLS | Image loading causes layout shift | Aspect ratio containers |
| INP | Gallery interactions | Optimized event handlers |
| FCP | Critical CSS + inline styles | Above-fold priority loading |

## 9.16 Quality Review & Risk Matrix

### 9.16.1 Critical Risks

| # | Risk | Impact | Mitigation |
|---|------|--------|------------|
| C1 | Cloudinary service outage | All media unavailable | Cloudinary 99.95% SLA, SW cache |
| C2 | API secret exposure | Full Cloudinary access | Server-only, never in frontend |
| C3 | Mass delete without backup | Permanent data loss | Soft delete + usage protection |
| C4 | DDoS on upload endpoints | Storage exhaustion | Rate limiting (20 req/min) |

### 9.16.2 High Risks

| # | Risk | Impact | Mitigation |
|---|------|--------|------------|
| H1 | Drift between DB and Cloudinary | Broken references | Drift detection (24h) |
| H2 | Large video uploads (>100MB) | Upload failures | Size validation + timeouts |
| H3 | Orphaned assets consuming storage | Cost increase | Background cleanup service |
| H4 | Missing alt text on images | Accessibility violation | Required field on upload |
| H5 | Inconsistent folder structure | Navigation confusion | Path generation rules |

### 9.16.3 Medium Risks

| # | Risk | Impact | Mitigation |
|---|------|--------|------------|
| M1 | Double extension breaking `f_auto` | Broken images | `stripDoubleExtension()` |
| M2 | No blur placeholder implemented | Poor perceived performance | Pulse skeleton fallback |
| M3 | No image cropping tool | Limited admin editing | Cloudinary URL transforms |
| M4 | No Cloudinary webhooks | No real-time sync | Polling drift detection |
| M5 | Avatar URL not tracked via publicId | Can't delete old avatars | Manual cleanup needed |
| M6 | Reviews/Returns use TEXT[] not media_assets | Inconsistent tracking | Future migration needed |

### 9.16.4 Low Risks

| # | Risk | Impact | Mitigation |
|---|------|--------|------------|
| L1 | No video player library | Limited playback features | Native HTML5 `<video>` |
| L2 | No document viewer | Can't preview PDFs inline | Link to browser viewer |
| L3 | Static service worker version | Requires page refresh for updates | SW lifecycle management |
| L4 | No image editing capabilities | Must use external tools | Cloudinary transforms |

### 9.16.5 Scalability Assessment

| Dimension | Current | Limit | Concern Level |
|-----------|---------|-------|--------------|
| Storage | ~5GB estimated | Cloudinary free: 25GB | Low |
| Bandwidth | ~50GB/month estimated | Cloudinary free: 25GB/month | Medium |
| API Calls | ~1000/month estimated | Cloudinary free: 25K/month | Low |
| Database Rows | ~500 media_assets | PostgreSQL: unlimited | Low |
| Admin Users | 1-3 | Rate limited | Low |
| Concurrent Uploads | 1-3 | 20 req/min limit | Low |

### 9.16.6 Maintainability Assessment

| Aspect | Rating | Notes |
|--------|--------|-------|
| Code Organization | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ | Well-structured service layers |
| Type Safety | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ | TypeScript throughout |
| Error Handling | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ | Comprehensive error hierarchy |
| Testing | ⭐⭐⭐ | Unit tests exist, integration tests present |
| Documentation | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ | Good inline docs, this phase adds more |
| Monitoring | ⭐⭐⭐ | Audit logs + integrity service |
| Backup Strategy | ⭐⭐ | Soft delete only, no Cloudinary backup |

# PHASE 10 — Storefront Customer Journey & Commerce Architecture

---

## Executive Summary

Phase 10 documents the complete customer-facing storefront of নবME — from landing to returns and everything between. The storefront is a React 19 + Vite SPA with client-side routing (React Router DOM v7), server-side SEO via Cloudflare Pages middleware, and a comprehensive CMS-driven homepage system. Every page is code-split via `React.lazy()`, wrapped in error boundaries, and animated with Framer Motion.

**Architecture:** SPA (React 19 + Vite 6) + Cloudflare Pages Functions (API) + Prisma 6 (Neon PostgreSQL) + Supabase Auth (httpOnly cookies) + Razorpay (Payments) + Cloudinary (Media) + Resend (Email) + Cloudflare Turnstile (Bot Protection)

**Key Metrics:**
- 23 storefront pages (all code-split)
- 14 CMS section renderers (all lazy-loaded)
- 13 storefront hooks
- 27 storefront components
- 16 shared UI components
- 50+ API endpoints for customer-facing features
- 40+ database models
- 14 E2E test specs covering customer journeys
- Full PWA with offline support

## 10.2 Storefront Architecture

### 10.2.1 Routing Architecture

**File:** `src/app/routes.tsx`

All 23 storefront pages are defined in a single route file. Every page is:
1. Code-split via `React.lazy()`
2. Wrapped in `<ErrorBoundary>` with branded fallback
3. Rendered inside `<StorefrontLayout>`
4. Protected routes additionally wrapped in `<ProtectedRoute>`

**Route Map:**

| Path | Page Component | Protection |
|------|---------------|------------|
| `/` | `HomePage` | Public |
| `/products` | `ProductListingPage` | Public |
| `/products/:slug` | `ProductDetailPage` | Public |
| `/search` | `SearchResultsPage` | Public |
| `/cart` | `CartPage` | Public |
| `/wishlist` | `WishlistPage` | Public |
| `/collections` | `CollectionsIndexPage` | Public |
| `/collections/:slug` | `CollectionPage` | Public |
| `/categories/:slug` | `CategoryPage` | Public |
| `/checkout` | `CheckoutPage` | Public |
| `/lookbooks` | `LookbookPage` | Public |
| `/lookbooks/:slug` | `LookbookDetailPage` | Public |
| `/account` | `DashboardPage` | Protected |
| `/account/orders` | `OrdersPage` | Protected |
| `/account/orders/:id` | `OrderDetailPage` | Protected |
| `/account/orders/:id/tracking` | `OrderTrackingPage` | Protected |
| `/account/returns/:id` | `ReturnRequestPage` | Protected |
| `/account/wishlist` | `WishlistPage` | Protected |
| `/account/addresses` | `AddressesPage` | Protected |
| `/account/notifications` | `NotificationsPage` | Protected |
| `/account/settings` | `SettingsPage` | Protected |
| `/account/support` | `SupportTicketsPage` | Protected |
| `/:slug` | `StaticPage` | Public (catch-all) |

### 10.2.2 Layout System

**File:** `src/storefront/layout/Layout.tsx`

The `StorefrontLayout` component renders the complete storefront shell:

1. `<ScrollToTopOnNavigate />` — scrolls to top on route change
2. `<Helmet>` — full HTML head management (favicon, JSON-LD, Facebook Pixel, GTM, custom CSS)
3. `<Header />` — fixed position, two-tier desktop, single-row mobile
4. `<MobileNav />` — slide-in drawer from left (dark themed)
5. `<SearchOverlay />` — full-screen search overlay
6. `<CartDrawer />` — slide-in drawer from right
7. Skip-to-content link (accessibility)
8. `<main>` — with dynamic paddingTop (112px desktop, 64px mobile)
   - `<ErrorBoundary>` with branded fallback
   - `<AnimatePresence mode="wait">` with page transitions (fade+slide, respects reduced motion)
   - `<Outlet />` — nested route content
9. `<SocialProof />` — hidden during checkout
10. `<BottomNav />` — mobile only, hidden during checkout
11. `<ScrollToTop />` — floating button
12. `<Footer />` — full footer with newsletter, links, social

### 10.2.3 State Management

| Store | Technology | Purpose |
|-------|-----------|---------|
| `useAuthStore` | Zustand | User, isAuthenticated, isAdmin, isLoading |
| `useCartStore` | Zustand + persist | Cart items, coupon, discount, user-scoped localStorage |
| `useUIStore` | Zustand | Search, mobile menu, cart drawer, mega menu state |
| `useConnectivityStore` | Zustand | Online/offline status, emergency mode |
| TanStack Query | Server state | Products, settings, navigation, CMS data |
| localStorage | Browser storage | Recently viewed, product comparison, cookie consent |

### 10.2.4 API Client Architecture

**File:** `src/lib/api/client.ts`

The API client provides:
- **Automatic token refresh:** On 401, attempts refresh via `POST /api/auth/refresh` with CSRF token
- **CSRF protection:** Reads `csrf_token` from cookies, sends as `X-CSRF-Token` header
- **Smart 401 handling:** Self-service auth endpoints surface server errors; non-auth endpoints trigger refresh-or-logout
- **Transient failure protection:** 5xx, 502/503/504, 429, and network errors do NOT trigger logout
- **AbortController with timeout:** Default 30-second timeout on all requests
- **Retry logic:** Max 2 retries on refresh with shared promise (prevents thundering herd)

## 10.3 Home Page & Landing Experience

### 10.3.1 Homepage Architecture

**File:** `src/storefront/pages/HomePage.tsx`

**Data Flow:**
1. Fetches site settings via `useSettings()`
2. Fetches homepage sections via `useQuery(["homepage"])` → `GET /api/homepage`
3. Falls back to featured products if no CMS sections exist

**Three Rendering Paths:**

| Path | Trigger | Content |
|------|---------|---------|
| **Fallback** | No CMS sections | Hardcoded hero + featured products |
| **Loading** | Data fetching | Full-screen spinner |
| **Error** | API failure | Rich error state with CTAs |
| **Success** | CMS data loaded | Dynamic section rendering via `<SectionRenderer>` |

## 10.5 Search Experience

### 10.5.1 Search Overlay

**File:** `src/storefront/layout/SearchOverlay.tsx`

Full-screen overlay with three states:

**State 1 — No Query (Idle):**
- Two-column layout: "Trending" (left) + "Categories" (right)
- Bottom section: "Recent Searches" as pill chips
- Fallback trending terms: "Summer Dresses", "Linen Shirts", "Leather Bags", "Sneakers", "Silk Scarves"

**State 2 — Query with Results:**
- Category matching tags
- Autocomplete suggestions (thumbnail + name + price)
- Product grid (2-col mobile, 4-col desktop, max 8)
- "View all X results" link

**State 3 — Query with No Results:**
- Centered empty state

**Features:**
- 300ms debounce on search input
- Recent searches stored in localStorage (per user ID)
- Auto-focus on input when opened
- Body scroll lock
- Focus trap for accessibility
- API: `GET /api/search/trending` + `GET /api/products/autocomplete?q=`

### 10.5.2 Search API

**File:** `api/_handlers/search.ts`

Five distinct actions:

| Action | Auth | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `suggestions` | No | Fuzzy autocomplete using PostgreSQL `pg_trgm` extension |
| `recent` | Yes | Last 10 user searches from `search_history` |
| `trending` | No | Top 10 trending searches from last 7 days |
| `save` | Recommended | Persists search query + updates trending counters |
| `clear` | Yes | Deletes all user search history |

**pg_trgm Implementation:**
- Product suggestions: similarity scoring weighted 10x on name, 5x on short_description
- Category suggestions: similarity on name (10x) and description (5x)
- Brand suggestions: similarity on name (10x)
- All use `%` trigram operator for fuzzy matching

**Search History Management:**
- Max 20 searches per user
- Deduplication (updates timestamp)
- Trending counter incremented atomically

### 10.5.3 Search Results Page

**File:** `src/storefront/pages/SearchResultsPage.tsx`

- URL-driven search via `q` parameter
- Product grid with quick view
- Pagination with Previous/Next buttons
- Error state with retry
- Empty state: suggestions for browsing collections/products
- SEO: `noindex, follow` robots directive

## 10.8 Shopping Cart

### 10.8.1 Cart Store

**File:** `src/storefront/stores/cart-store.ts`

**Persistence Strategy:**
- Zustand store with `persist` middleware
- User-scoped localStorage keys: `nabome-cart-{userId}` or `nabome-cart-guest`
- Custom `userCartStorage` adapter for key isolation

**Cart Item Interface:**
- `id` (client-generated UUID)
- `productId`, `variantId`, `name`, `slug`, `sku`
- `size`, `color`, `colorHex`, `image`
- `price`, `compareAtPrice`, `quantity`, `maxQuantity`

**Actions:**
| Action | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `addItem(item)` | Add variant or increment quantity (capped at maxQuantity) |
| `removeItem(variantId)` | Remove item by variant ID |
| `updateQuantity(variantId, qty)` | Update quantity (removes if < 1) |
| `clearCart()` | Reset all items, coupon, discount |
| `applyCoupon(code, discount, type)` | Store coupon details |
| `removeCoupon()` | Clear coupon |
| `switchUser()` | Handle auth state changes |
| `applyServerCart(payload)` | Replace local with server cart |

**Computed Values:**
- `itemCount`: Sum of all quantities
- `subtotal`: Sum of `price * quantity`
- `discountAmount`: Capped to subtotal
- `total`: `max(0, subtotal - discountAmount)`, rounded to 2 decimals

### 10.8.2 Cart Sync

**File:** `src/storefront/hooks/useCartSync.ts`

**Server Synchronization:**
- Debounced (250ms) sync for authenticated users
- Max 3 sync failures before callback
- Hydration from server on mount
- Guest-to-authenticated merge via `POST /api/cart/merge`

**API Endpoints:**
- `POST /api/cart/sync` — replace server cart
- `GET /api/cart` — hydrate from server
- `POST /api/cart/merge` — merge guest items

### 10.8.3 Cart Drawer

**Slide-in panel from right:**
- Spring animation (damping: 30, stiffness: 300)

- Max width: 480px (desktop), full width (mobile)

**States:**
1. **Empty:** Shopping bag icon, "Your bag is empty", "Continue Shopping"
2. **With Items:** Scrollable item list + fixed footer

**Item Display:**

- Name, size, color labels

- Quantity controls (minus → trash icon at qty=1)
- Price display

**Footer Summary:**

### 10.8.5 Cart API

**File:** `api/_handlers/cart.ts`

| Action | Method | Auth | Description |
|--------|--------|------|-------------|
| `get` | GET | Yes | Get server cart with variant details |
| `sync` | POST | Yes | Replace server cart items |
| `merge` | POST | Yes | Merge guest items into server cart |
| `clear` | POST | Yes | Clear all cart items |

**Cart TTL:** 7 days (extended on each sync)

### 10.8.6 Guest vs Authenticated Cart

| Aspect | Guest | Authenticated |
|--------|-------|---------------|
| Storage | localStorage only | localStorage + server |
| Sync | No | Debounced (250ms) |
| Merge on login | Guest → server | N/A |
| Checkout | Items in request body | Items in request body |
| Post-checkout | Client clears | Server clears in transaction |

- Subtotal, shipping, tax, discount, total
- All prices formatted with `formatPrice()`

### 10.9.4 Checkout API

**File:** `api/_handlers/checkout.ts`

**Two endpoints:**
- `POST /api/checkout` — authenticated checkout
- `POST /api/checkout/guest` — guest checkout

**Request Body:**
- `email`, `shippingAddressId` or `shippingAddress`, `billingAddressId` or `billingAddress`
- `sameAsShipping`, `couponCode`, `giftMessage`, `notes`, `paymentMethod`
- `items` (array of `{variantId, quantity}`)

**Transaction Flow (15-second timeout):**
1. Reserve stock (decrement stock, increment reservedStock)
2. Create order with calculated amounts
3. Create order items with product snapshots
4. Record inventory movements
5. Update coupon usage + create redemption record
6. Clear server cart
7. Create in-app notification (`order_placed`)

**Post-Transaction:**
- Send order confirmation email (silent failure)
- Log audit action
- Complete referral (silent failure)
- Return `{ order, razorpayOrderId }`

## 10.10 Payment Flow

### 10.10.1 Razorpay Integration

**Files:** `src/lib/razorpay/`

**Script Loading** (`load-script.ts`):
- Idempotent: checks `window.Razorpay` first
- Loads `https://checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js`
- Returns Promise (resolves on load, rejects on error)

**useRazorpay Hook** (`use-razorpay.ts`):
- `loaded`: boolean — script loaded state
- `openRazorpay(params)`: Opens Razorpay modal
  - Amount in paise (`amount * 100`)
  - Currency: INR
  - Theme color: `#B8860B` (gold)
  - Prefill: name, email, contact
  - On success: resolves with payment/order/signature IDs
  - On dismiss: rejects with "Payment cancelled"
  - On failure: rejects with error details

### 10.10.2 Payment API

**File:** `api/_handlers/payments.ts`

| Action | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `verify` | Client-side payment verification (HMAC-SHA256) |
| `failed` | Report payment failure (releases inventory) |
| `retry` | Retry failed payment (creates new Razorpay order) |
| `refund` | Process refund (admin only) |
| `webhook` | Razorpay webhook receiver |

**Verification Flow:**
1. HMAC-SHA256 signature verification with timing-safe comparison
2. Duplicate payment ID check
3. Transaction: update order status, create status history, create notification
4. Send payment success email

**Webhook Events:**
| Event | Handler |
|-------|---------|
| `payment.captured` | Mark paid, confirm, notify, email |
| `payment.failed` | Mark failed, release inventory, notify, email |
| `refund.created` | Create refund record |
| `refund.processed` | Update refund status |

**Security:**
- HMAC-SHA256 signature verification
- Timing-safe comparison
- Max body size: 256KB
- Deduplication via `webhook_events` table unique constraint
- Retry limit: 3 attempts

## 10.11 Order Lifecycle

### 10.11.1 Order Status Flow

```
pending → confirmed → processing → packed → shipped → out_for_delivery → delivered
    ↓         ↓            ↓           ↓         ↓              ↓              ↓
cancelled  cancelled   cancelled   cancelled  returned      returned      returned
                                                                   ↓
                                                              returned → refunded
```

### 10.11.2 Orders Page

**File:** `src/storefront/pages/OrdersPage.tsx`

- Dashboard layout with `DashboardSidebar`
- Status filter tabs (All, Pending, Processing, Shipped, Delivered, Cancelled)
- Order cards: package icon, order number, date, item count, status badge, total
- Pagination (numbered buttons)

### 10.11.3 Order Detail

**File:** `src/storefront/pages/OrderDetailPage.tsx`

**Sections:**
1. Header: order number, date, status badge, payment status badge
2. Order timeline: vertical timeline with icons per status
3. Items list: image, name, size/color, quantity, price
4. Shipping address: full details
5. Payment info: subtotal, shipping, tax, discount, total, payment method

**Actions (conditional):**
- `pending`/`confirmed`: Cancel Order
- `delivered`: Return/Exchange
- `shipped`/`processing`/`out_for_delivery`: Track Package
- Always: Download Invoice

### 10.11.4 Order Tracking

### 10.11.5 Orders API

**File:** `api/_handlers/orders.ts`

| Endpoint | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `GET /list` | Paginated orders with status filter |

## 10.17 Coupon System

### 10.17.1 Coupon Validation

**API:** `POST /api/coupons/validate`

**Validation Chain:**
1. Code exists (case-insensitive)
2. `isActive` flag
3. Date range (start ≤ now ≤ end)
4. Usage limit (usedCount < usageLimit)
5. Gender applicability
6. Per-user limit
7. Minimum order value

**Discount Calculation:**
- Percentage: `(subtotal * discountValue / 100)`, capped at maxDiscount
- Fixed: `discountValue` directly

## 10.19 Accessibility Review

### 10.19.1 Keyboard Navigation

- **Skip to content link:** Visible on focus, links to `#main-content`
- **Focus traps:** All modals/dialogs trap focus with `useFocusTrap` hook
- **Arrow key navigation:** Available in lists and menus
- **Escape key:** Closes overlays, modals, drawers
- **Tab wrapping:** First ↔ last element in trapped contexts

### 10.19.2 ARIA Implementation

- `aria-label` on all icon buttons and interactive elements
- `aria-expanded` on toggle buttons
- `aria-current="page"` on active navigation
- `aria-live="polite"` on cart badge and social proof
- `aria-live="assertive"` on toasts
- `aria-invalid` and `aria-describedby` on form fields
- `aria-modal="true"` on dialogs
- `role="dialog"` on modals
- `role="status"` on loading indicators

### 10.19.3 Color & Contrast

- Universal `*:focus-visible` ring: `ring-2 ring-brand-500/40 ring-offset-2`
- Color contrast checker utility (`checkColorContrast`)
- WCAG AA compliance (4.5:1 ratio)
- WCAG AAA support (7:1 ratio)

### 10.19.4 Screen Reader Support

- `announceToScreenReader()` utility for dynamic content
- `srOnly()` and `visuallyHidden()` CSS utilities
- `getAccessibleName()` for resolving accessible names
- Semantic HTML structure throughout

### 10.19.5 Reduced Motion

- `useReducedMotion()` hook checks `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`
- All Framer Motion animations respect this preference
- Page transitions use opacity-only fallback
- Scroll-triggered animations disabled

### 10.19.6 Form Accessibility

- All fields have `<label>` elements with `htmlFor`
- Required fields marked with `aria-required="true"`
- Error states use `aria-invalid` + `aria-describedby`
- Password toggle: `aria-label="Show/Hide password"`
- Phone input: `type="tel"`, proper `inputMode`

## 10.20 Performance Review

### 10.20.1 Build Optimization

- **LightningCSS** for CSS minification (faster than esbuild)
- **esbuild** for JS minification
- **ES2020 target** — smaller transpiled output
- **Asset inline limit:** 4096 bytes (base64-inlined)
- **Source maps disabled** in production
- **Admin chunk filtering:** Strips `<link rel="modulepreload">` for admin chunks
- **React deduplication:** Prevents multiple React instances

### 10.20.2 Code Splitting

- All 23 storefront pages: `React.lazy()`
- All 13 CMS sections: `React.lazy()`
- Admin routes: separate lazy loading
- Error boundaries on every code-split route

### 10.20.3 Image Optimization

- **Cloudinary presets:** thumbnail (200x200), small (400x400), medium (800x800), large (1200x1200), hero (1920x1080)
- **8 responsive breakpoints:** 320, 480, 640, 768, 1024, 1280, 1536, 1920
- **LazyLoader class:** IntersectionObserver with 50px rootMargin
- **`content-visibility: auto`** on lazy images
- **WebP format** via Cloudinary `f_auto`
- **DPR 2.0** for retina displays

### 10.20.4 Core Web Vitals Monitoring

**File:** `src/lib/performance-monitor.ts`

Full implementation:
- **FCP** (First Contentful Paint) via PerformanceObserver
- **LCP** (Largest Contentful Paint) via PerformanceObserver
- **FID** (First Input Delay) via PerformanceObserver
- **CLS** (Cumulative Layout Shift) via PerformanceObserver
- **TTFB** (Time to First Byte) from navigation timing
- All metrics sent to Google Analytics in production

### 10.20.5 Caching Strategy

| Resource | Cache-Control |
|----------|---------------|
| JS/CSS assets | `max-age=31536000, immutable` |
| Images | `max-age=31536000, immutable` |
| Favicon/manifest | `max-age=86400, stale-while-revalidate=604800` |
| index.html | `max-age=0, must-revalidate` |
| API routes | `no-store, no-cache` |
| robots.txt | `max-age=86400, stale-while-revalidate=604800` |

### 10.20.6 Service Worker

**File:** `src/lib/serviceWorker.ts`

- Registers at `/sw.js` with scope `/`
- Update detection: fires `sw:update` custom event
- Periodic sync: `content-sync` every hour
- Enhanced offline detection for mobile (5s polling)
- 10-second registration timeout
- Never rejects — app works without service worker

### 10.20.7 In-Memory Cache

- Generic `Cache<T>` class with configurable TTL (default 5 minutes)
- Automatic expiration on `get()`
- `QueryOptimizer` with debounce, throttle, batch processing

### 10.20.8 CSS Performance

- `gpu-accelerate`: forces GPU compositing with `translateZ(0)`
- `transition-gpu`: GPU-accelerated transitions with `will-change`
- `fixed-gpu`: fixes iOS Safari `position: fixed` bug
- `backdrop-blur-premium`: `-webkit-backdrop-filter` for Safari
- `momentum-scroll`: `-webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch`

## 10.21 SEO Review

### 10.21.1 Server-Side SEO (Middleware)

**File:** `functions/_middleware.ts`

**Full SSR SEO layer** running as Cloudflare Pages middleware:
1. Intercepts all HTML requests (excludes API, static assets)
2. Fetches page-specific metadata from database via Prisma
3. Generates per-page SEO: title, description (160 chars), canonical, OG, Twitter, JSON-LD
4. Injects meta tags into `<head>` via regex
5. Handles pagination with `rel="prev"`/`rel="next"`
6. Applies `noindex, nofollow` to protected routes
7. Redirects trailing slashes with 301
8. In-memory SEO cache (10s TTL, max 500 entries, LRU pruning)
9. SPA fallback for 404 responses

### 10.21.2 Schema.org Structured Data

| Schema | Pages |
|--------|-------|
| WebSite + SearchAction | Homepage |
| Organization | All pages |
| Product + AggregateOffer | Product detail |
| BreadcrumbList | Product, category, collection, lookbook |
| CollectionPage | Category, collection |
| Article | Lookbook, static pages |
| FAQPage | FAQ page |

### 10.21.3 Open Graph & Twitter Cards

- `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:type`, `og:url`, `og:site_name`, `og:locale`, `og:image`
- Twitter: `summary_large_image` card type
- Article meta: `published_time`, `modified_time`

### 10.21.4 robots.txt

**Disallows:** `/admin/`, `/auth/`, `/account/`, `/cart/`, `/checkout/`, `/orders/`, `/returns/`, `/support/`, `/wishlist/`, `/api/`, search/filter URLs with query params

**Allows:** Clean product, category, collection, lookbook pages

**Crawl-delay:** 1 (respectful crawling)

### 10.21.5 Client-Side SEO

**File:** `src/components/SEOHead.tsx`

- `react-helmet-async` for dynamic `<title>`, meta, canonical, OG, Twitter
- Brand suffix: `— নবME`
- JSON-LD structured data support

### 10.21.6 Image SEO

- Cloudinary: `f_auto` (auto format), `q_auto:best` (auto quality), `dpr_2.0`
- Responsive srcSet: 5 widths (320, 640, 960, 1280, 1920) in WebP
- Double extension fix for `f_auto` compatibility
- Fallback: `/placeholder.svg` for missing images

## 10.23 Risk Matrix

### Critical Risks

| Risk | Impact | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|------|--------|------------|------------|
| Razorpay payment failure | Lost revenue | Medium | Retry flow, COD fallback, webhook reconciliation |
| Stock overselling | Customer dissatisfaction | Low | Transaction-level stock validation, reserved stock |
| Cart sync failure | Lost items | Low | LocalStorage persistence, retry logic (3 attempts) |
| Session hijacking | Account compromise | Low | httpOnly cookies, token hashing, idle timeout |

### High Risks

| Risk | Impact | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|------|--------|------------|------------|
| SEO middleware regex failure | Lost search ranking | Medium | Comprehensive test coverage, fallback SPA routing |
| Email delivery failure | Missed notifications | Medium | Silent failure, in-app notification backup |
| Coupon race condition | Discount abuse | Low | Transaction-level validation, per-user limits |
| Image CDN outage | Broken images | Low | SafeImage retry logic, branded fallback |

### Medium Risks

| Risk | Impact | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|------|--------|------------|------------|
| Service worker polling (5s mobile) | Battery drain | Low | Configurable intervals, graceful degradation |
| Large bundle size | Slow initial load | Medium | Code splitting, lazy loading, admin chunk filtering |
| Form validation bypass | Data integrity | Low | Server-side validation via Zod schemas |
| Accessibility gaps | Legal/compliance | Medium | Comprehensive a11y library, ARIA attributes |

### Low Risks

| Risk | Impact | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|------|--------|------------|------------|
| localStorage quota | Cart persistence | Low | Server sync for authenticated users |
| Browser compatibility | UX degradation | Low | Modern browser target, graceful fallbacks |
| Type staleness | Runtime errors | Low | Zod-inferred types, comprehensive interfaces |

## 10.27 Quality Review

### Critical Issues

| Issue | Component | Impact | Status |
|-------|-----------|--------|--------|
| None identified | — | — | — |

### High Priority Issues

| Issue | Component | Impact | Recommendation |
|-------|-----------|--------|----------------|
| Middleware regex fragility | SEO | Meta injection could break if HTML structure changes | Add middleware HTML snapshot tests |
| Service worker 5s polling (mobile) | Performance | Battery drain on mobile devices | Increase to 15-30s or use event-driven sync |
| No sitemap.xml generator | SEO | Search engines may miss deep pages | Implement dynamic sitemap generation |
| `popular`/`best_selling` sort fallback | Products | These sort options fall through to default | Implement actual popularity/销量 sorting |

### Medium Priority Issues

| Issue | Component | Impact | Recommendation |
|-------|-----------|--------|----------------|
| Dual hook implementations | useWishlist, Breadcrumbs, ImageGallery | Confusion about which to use | Consolidate or clearly document usage |
| Coupon state not persisted server-side | Cart | Coupon lost on server cart fetch | Persist coupon in cart model |
| AuthResponse type includes tokens | Types | Legacy type may cause confusion | Remove token fields, document cookie-only auth |
| No tablet-optimized layouts | Responsive | Tablet experience uses generic responsive | Consider tablet-specific breakpoints |

### Low Priority Issues

| Issue | Component | Impact | Recommendation |
|-------|-----------|--------|----------------|
| Silent error catches | Various | Some errors may go unreported in production | Add structured error reporting (Sentry) |
| FAQ schema hardcoded | SEO | FAQ content not dynamic | Fetch from CMS FAQ data |
| Admin chunk preloading filtered | Performance | Vite generates unnecessary preload links | Upstream Vite fix or custom plugin |

### Technical Debt

1. **Dual component implementations** — Two versions of Breadcrumbs, ImageGallery, VariantSelector (UI vs storefront). Consolidation recommended.
2. **AuthResponse type staleness** — Type includes accessToken/refreshToken but implementation uses httpOnly cookies only.
3. **Middleware regex approach** — Server-side SEO injection uses regex on HTML, which is inherently fragile.
4. **Service worker complexity** — Multiple polling strategies and sync mechanisms increase maintenance burden.

## 11.1 Executive Summary

### Admin Portal Overview

The NABOME admin portal is a comprehensive back-office management system built as a React SPA with lazy-loaded route chunks. It provides complete control over the e-commerce platform including product catalog, orders, customers, CMS, analytics, and system configuration.

### Scale

| Metric | Count |
|--------|-------|
| Admin UI Pages (src/admin/) | 37 page files |
| Admin UI Components (src/admin/) | 20 component files |
| Admin Common/Shared Components | 14 files |
| Admin API Handlers (api/_handlers/admin/) | 36 handler files |
| Admin API Clients (src/lib/api/admin/) | 8 files |
| CMS Core Files (src/cms/) | 3 files |
| Media Library (src/lib/media/) | 17 files |
| Types (src/types/) | 9 type definition files |
| Prisma Seed Files | 46 files |
| E2E Tests (admin-related) | 8 files |
| API Tests (admin-related) | 3 files |
| **Total Unique Source Files** | **~213 files** |

### Technology Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|-------|-----------|
| Framework | React 19.1.0 + React Router 7.5.0 |
| State Management | Zustand (auth) + TanStack Query 5.75.5 (server state) |
| Styling | Tailwind CSS 3.4.17 |
| Animations | Framer Motion |
| Icons | Lucide React |
| Build | Vite 6.3.2 with code splitting |
| Backend | Cloudflare Pages Functions (Edge) |
| Database | PostgreSQL (Neon Serverless) via Prisma 6.6.0 |
| Auth | Supabase Auth with httpOnly cookies |
| Media | Cloudinary |
| Payments | Razorpay |

```typescript
/admin/labels                    → LabelsPage
/admin/inventory                 → InventoryPage
```

### Lazy Loading Strategy

All admin pages use `lazyWithRetry` — a wrapper around `React.lazy` with automatic retry on chunk load failure (1-second delay):

```typescript
function lazyWithRetry(factory) {
  return lazy(() => factory().catch(() => {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      setTimeout(() => resolve(factory()), 1000);
    });
  }));
}
```

**Benefit:** Each admin page is a separate chunk, reducing initial bundle size.

### Layout Architecture

**AdminLayout.tsx** (305 lines) provides:

1. **Fixed Sidebar** (w-72, dark background):
   - Brand logo "নবME" with "Admin" badge
   - Navigation items with icons (Lucide)
   - Expandable/collapsible menu groups
   - Active state highlighting (accent-gold)
   - Scroll position persistence via localStorage
   - Expanded menu state persistence via localStorage

2. **Sticky Header** (h-16):
   - Mobile hamburger menu button
   - User name + role display
   - "View Site" link (opens storefront in new tab)
   - "Sign Out" button

3. **Main Content Area**:
   - `<Outlet />` for nested route content
   - Responsive padding (p-4 → p-6 on lg)

4. **Mobile Support**:
   - Overlay backdrop when sidebar open
   - Escape key to close sidebar
   - Sidebar slides in/out with transform transition

### Route Protection

1. **AdminRoute** (`src/components/auth/AdminRoute.tsx`):
   - Wraps children with `ProtectedRoute requireAdmin`
   - Checks `useAuthStore` for `isAuthenticated` and `isAdmin`

2. **ProtectedRoute** (`src/components/auth/ProtectedRoute.tsx`):
   - Shows loading spinner while auth state is resolving
   - Redirects to `/auth/login` if not authenticated
   - Redirects to `/` if `requireAdmin` but user is not admin

3. **Role Check** (`src/stores/auth-store.ts`):
   - `isAdmin: user.role === "admin"` — single role check
   - No granular permissions; binary admin/non-admin

### Error Handling

- **ErrorBoundary** wraps entire admin route tree
- Per-route `key={location.pathname}` ensures fresh error boundary per page
- Custom error fallback with "Try Again" and "Back to Dashboard" buttons
- 404 catch-all route for undefined admin paths

## 11.29 Responsive Design

### Breakpoints
| Breakpoint | Width | Sidebar | Grid |
|-----------|-------|---------|------|
| Mobile | <640px | Hidden (overlay) | 1-2 columns |
| Tablet | 640-1024px | Hidden (overlay) | 2-3 columns |
| Laptop | 1024-1280px | Visible | 3-4 columns |
| Desktop | >1280px | Visible | 4-5 columns |

### Admin Layout Responsive Behavior
- **Sidebar**: Fixed w-72 on lg+, hidden with overlay on smaller screens
- **Header**: Full-width, sticky, with mobile hamburger
- **Content**: Responsive padding (p-4 → p-6 on lg+)
- **Tables**: Horizontal scroll on small screens
- **Grids**: Responsive column counts

### Component Responsive Patterns
- **Stats Cards**: 1→2→4 column grid
- **Filter Bars**: Wrap on small screens
- **Modals**: Full-width on mobile, centered on desktop
- **Forms**: Single column on mobile, multi-column on desktop
- **Navigation**: Collapsible sidebar with overlay on mobile

## 11.30 Performance

### Code Splitting
- All 37 admin pages use `React.lazy` with retry
- Each page is a separate chunk
- Initial load: Dashboard only
- Other pages load on demand

### Data Fetching
- TanStack Query for server state caching
- Debounced search (300ms) to reduce API calls
- Pagination (20 items per page) to limit data transfer
- Query invalidation on mutations for fresh data

### Rendering Optimization
- Memoized computations (`useMemo`, `useCallback`)
- Virtual scrolling not implemented (data sets < 100 items typical)
- Skeleton loading states for perceived performance
- Optimistic updates for mutations

### Known Performance Considerations
- Dashboard daily sales chart renders 30 SVG bars (acceptable)
- Media library handles 1000+ assets with pagination
- Product list with 20 items per page renders smoothly
- Large form (ProductFormPage 834 lines) — could benefit from virtualization

---

## 11.31 Security Review

### Authentication
- Admin check: `user.role === "admin"` (binary)
- httpOnly cookies for token storage (no localStorage)
- Supabase Auth with JWT verification

### Authorization
- `ProtectedRoute` with `requireAdmin` prop
- Server-side role check in API handlers
- No granular permissions (admin = full access)

### RBAC
- **Current**: Single "admin" role with full access
- **Seed Data**: Roles and permissions tables exist but not enforced in UI
- **Future**: Multi-role support ready in database schema

### Dangerous Actions
- Permanent product deletion (irreversible)
- Bulk operations (multiple items affected)
- Settings changes (affect entire store)
- Role changes (customer → admin)

### Audit Logging
- All admin actions logged to audit_log table
- Includes: action, entity, entityId, userId, metadata, timestamp
- Viewable in Audit Log page

### Session Security
- Auth state in memory only (Zustand)
- No localStorage persistence for tokens
- Session tracking in Auth Activity page

### Admin Isolation
- Admin portal at `/admin/*` path
- Separate layout from storefront
- `noindex, nofollow` meta tag
- No public links to admin

---

## 11.32 Admin ↔ Storefront Flow

### Product Publishing
```
Admin creates/edits product → API validates → Product saved (isActive=true)
→ Storefront queries published products → Product appears in catalog
```

### Inventory Update
```
Admin adjusts stock → Inventory API updates variant stock
→ Stock alert generated if below threshold
→ Storefront shows updated stock availability
```

### Price Update
```
Admin updates product price → Product API saves new price
→ Storefront displays updated price
→ Cart recalculates if item in cart
```

### Media Upload
```
Admin uploads to Cloudinary → URL saved to database
→ Product/CMS references media URL
→ Storefront loads from Cloudinary CDN
```

### Homepage Update
```
Admin edits homepage sections → CMS API saves configuration
→ Storefront fetches CMS data → Homepage renders updated sections
```

### CMS Update
```
Admin edits page content → CMS API saves page data
→ Storefront fetches page by slug → Content renders
```

### Order Processing
```
Customer places order → Order created (pending)
→ Admin views in Orders page → Updates status
→ Customer receives notification
→ Status flows: pending → confirmed → processing → packed → shipped → delivered
```

### Refund
```
Admin reviews return request → Approves → Creates refund
→ Razorpay processes refund → Refund status updated
→ Customer notified
```

### Coupon
```
Admin creates coupon → Coupon active in system
→ Customer applies at checkout → Discount calculated
→ Redemption recorded → Coupon usage count incremented
```

### Campaign
```
Admin creates campaign → Campaign active for date range
→ Campaign type determines visibility (email/banner/popup)
→ Analytics track campaign performance
```

## 11.33 Quality Review

### Critical Issues
| Issue | Impact | Location |
|-------|--------|----------|
| Single admin role only | No granular access control | auth-store.ts |
| No CSRF protection on admin routes | Potential CSRF attacks | API handlers |
| Secrets may be in git history | Security risk | .env files |

### High Priority Issues
| Issue | Impact | Location |
|-------|--------|----------|
| No bulk product import validation | CSV errors not caught early | import-export |
| No real-time inventory sync | Race conditions possible | inventory |
| No rate limiting on admin API | Brute force potential | API handlers |
| Admin bundle size could be optimized | Slower initial load | AdminRoutes.tsx |

### Medium Priority Issues
| Issue | Impact | Location |
|-------|--------|----------|
| No undo for bulk operations | Data loss risk | products, orders |
| Limited search capabilities | Full-text search missing | search |
| No export for customers | Manual data extraction needed | customers |
| No email preview in templates | Can't verify email content | notifications |

### Low Priority Issues
| Issue | Impact | Location |
|-------|--------|----------|
| No dark mode for admin | User preference | AdminLayout |
| Limited chart types | Basic analytics only | analytics |
| No keyboard shortcuts | Power user efficiency | various |
| No admin activity feed | No real-time updates | dashboard |

### Technical Debt
1. **Dual component implementations** — Two versions of some components (MediaLibrary vs MediaLibraryNew)
2. **Type safety** — Many `as unknown as Type` casts in admin pages
3. **Error handling** — Inconsistent error display patterns across pages
4. **Form validation** — Mixed client-side validation approaches

## 11.35 Risk Matrix

### Business Risks
| Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation |
|------|-----------|--------|------------|
| No multi-role admin | High | Medium | Role-based access in database |
| Single admin account compromise | Low | High | 2FA readiness, audit logging |
| Bulk operation data loss | Medium | High | Confirmation dialogs, soft delete |
| Inventory race conditions | Medium | Medium | Optimistic locking, stock reservations |

### Security Risks
| Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation |
|------|-----------|--------|------------|
| CSRF on admin actions | Medium | High | CSRF token implementation |
| XSS in CMS content | Low | Medium | Content sanitization |
| SQL injection | Low | High | Prisma parameterized queries |
| Admin session hijacking | Low | High | httpOnly cookies, short expiry |

### Performance Risks
| Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation |
|------|-----------|--------|------------|
| Large media library slow loads | Medium | Medium | Pagination, lazy loading |
| Dashboard slow on large datasets | Low | Medium | Indexed queries, caching |
| Bundle size growth | High | Medium | Code splitting, lazy loading |

### Operational Risks
| Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation |
|------|-----------|--------|------------|
| No backup/restore UI | High | Medium | Import/export, database backups |
| No real-time notifications | Medium | Low | WebSocket future implementation |
| Limited analytics | Medium | Low | External analytics integration |

## 12.1 Executive Summary

### Business Model

NABOME is a **single-brand Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) fashion e-commerce platform**. There is no multi-vendor, multi-seller, or marketplace component. The brand owns all products, inventory, pricing, and fulfillment.

### System Interactions

The platform connects 5 primary subsystems:

| Subsystem | Role | Key Technologies |
|-----------|------|-----------------|
| **Storefront** | Customer-facing SPA | React 19, React Router 7, Tailwind CSS, Zustand |
| **API Layer** | Backend business logic | Cloudflare Pages Functions, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL |
| **Authentication** | Identity & access | Supabase Auth, httpOnly cookies, JWT |
| **Media** | Image/video management | Cloudinary, media_assets table |
| **Payments** | Transaction processing | Razorpay, webhook_events table |

### Data Flow Summary

```
Customer → Storefront (React SPA) → API (Cloudflare Functions) → Prisma → PostgreSQL
                                                          ↓
                                                    Supabase Auth (JWT)
                                                    Razorpay (Payments)
                                                    Cloudinary (Media)
                                                    Resend (Email)
```

### Scale

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Database Models | 50+ tables |
| API Endpoints | 150+ routes |
| Frontend Pages | 30+ storefront, 37+ admin |
| Prisma Migrations | 16 migrations |
| Enums | 18 enum types |
| Indexes | 100+ database indexes |
| GIN Trigram Indexes | 10+ fuzzy search indexes |

### Deployment Architecture

```
│  │  Storefront: /products, /cart, /checkout, /account, etc.  │  │
│  │  Admin: /admin/* (lazy-loaded chunks)                     │  │
│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  │
└───────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────┘
                            │ HTTPS
┌───────────────────────────▼─────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Cloudflare Pages (CDN + Edge)                  │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  functions/_middleware.ts — SEO meta injection (Edge)     │   │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  functions/api/[[path]].ts — Functions proxy             │   │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  api/[...path].ts — Route registry (150+ routes)         │   │
│  │  ├── api/_handlers/auth.ts (1500+ lines)                 │   │
│  │  ├── api/_handlers/products.ts                           │   │
│  │  ├── api/_handlers/orders.ts                             │   │
│  │  ├── api/_handlers/checkout.ts                           │   │
│  │  ├── api/_handlers/cart.ts                               │   │
│  │  ├── api/_handlers/payments.ts                           │   │
│  │  ├── api/_handlers/admin/* (36 files)                    │   │
│  │  └── api/_lib/auth-middleware.ts                         │   │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
└──────────┬──────────────┬──────────────┬──────────────┬─────────┘
           │              │              │              │
    ┌──────▼──────┐ ┌─────▼─────┐ ┌──────▼──────┐ ┌────▼─────┐
    │  Neon DB    │ │ Supabase  │ │  Cloudinary │ │ Razorpay │
    │ PostgreSQL  │ │   Auth    │ │   Media     │ │ Payments │
    │ (Prisma)    │ │  (JWT)    │ │   (CDN)     │ │          │
    └─────────────┘ └───────────┘ └─────────────┘ └──────────┘
```

### Client-Side Architecture

```
src/
├── stores/           # Zustand state stores

├── lib/api/          # API client layer

│   ├── auth.ts            # Auth API methods
│   ├── customer.ts        # Customer API methods
│   └── admin/             # Admin API modules (8 files)
├── storefront/       # Storefront-specific code
│   ├── pages/             # Route pages
│   ├── components/        # UI components
│   ├── hooks/             # Storefront hooks (useCart, useSearch, etc.)
│   └── stores/            # Storefront-specific stores
├── admin/            # Admin portal (37 pages, 20 components)
├── components/       # Shared components
├── cms/              # CMS core library
└── types/            # TypeScript type definitions
```

## 12.3 Database Ownership Map

### Complete Entity Ownership

```
SYSTEM-OWNED (brand controls everything):
│
├── site_settings (singleton config)
```
