## 17.4 Observability

### 17.4.1 Metrics Collection

```typescript
// Custom metrics collection
class MetricsCollector {
  private metrics: Map<string, number[]> = new Map();
  private counters: Map<string, number> = new Map();
  private gauges: Map<string, number> = new Map();

  // Timer for latency measurement
  startTimer(name: string): () => number {
    const start = performance.now();
    return () => {
      const duration = performance.now() - start;
      this.recordHistogram(name, duration);
      return duration;
    };
  }

  // Histogram for distribution tracking
  recordHistogram(name: string, value: number): void {
    if (!this.metrics.has(name)) {
      this.metrics.set(name, []);
    }
    this.metrics.get(name)!.push(value);
  }

  // Counter for increments
  incrementCounter(name: string, value: number = 1): void {
    this.counters.set(name, (this.counters.get(name) || 0) + value);
  }

  // Gauge for current values
  setGauge(name: string, value: number): void {
    this.gauges.set(name, value);
  }

  // Get percentile from histogram
  getPercentile(name: string, percentile: number): number {
    const values = this.metrics.get(name) || [];
    if (values.length === 0) return 0;
    const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const index = Math.ceil((percentile / 100) * sorted.length) - 1;
    return sorted[Math.max(0, index)];
  }

  // Export all metrics
  export(): Record<string, unknown> {
    const histograms: Record<string, Record<string, number>> = {};
    for (const [name, values] of this.metrics) {
      histograms[name] = {
        count: values.length,
        min: Math.min(...values),
        max: Math.max(...values),
        avg: values.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / values.length,
        p50: this.getPercentile(name, 50),
        p95: this.getPercentile(name, 95),
        p99: this.getPercentile(name, 99),
      };
    }
    return {
      histograms,
      counters: Object.fromEntries(this.counters),
      gauges: Object.fromEntries(this.gauges),
    };
  }
}

export const metrics = new MetricsCollector();
```

### 17.4.3 Distributed Tracing

```
Request Flow with Trace IDs:

Browser → Cloudflare Edge → Worker Function → Database → Response

Trace ID generated at: Cloudflare Edge
Request ID generated at: Worker Function
Correlation ID: Shared across all operations within request
```

## 17.5 Uptime & Health Checks

### 17.5.1 Health Endpoint Implementation

```typescript
// functions/api/health.ts
interface HealthCheckResult {
  status: 'healthy' | 'degraded' | 'unhealthy';
  timestamp: string;
  version: string;
  uptime: number;
  checks: {
    database: ComponentHealth;
    cloudinary: ComponentHealth;
    cloudflare: ComponentHealth;
    email: ComponentHealth;
    search: ComponentHealth;
    payments: ComponentHealth;
  };
}

interface ComponentHealth {
  status: 'healthy' | 'degraded' | 'unhealthy';
  latencyMs: number;
  message?: string;
}

export const onRequestGet: PagesFunction = async (context) => {
  const startTime = Date.now();
  
  const checks = await Promise.allSettled([
    checkDatabase(context.env),
    checkCloudinary(context.env),
    checkCloudflare(),
    checkEmailService(context.env),
    checkSearch(),
    checkPayments(context.env),
  ]);

  const results: HealthCheckResult = {
    status: determineOverallStatus(checks),
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    version: context.env.APP_VERSION || 'unknown',
    uptime: Date.now() - BOOT_TIME,
    checks: {
      database: formatCheck(checks[0]),
      cloudinary: formatCheck(checks[1]),
      cloudflare: formatCheck(checks[2]),
      email: formatCheck(checks[3]),
      search: formatCheck(checks[4]),
      payments: formatCheck(checks[5]),
    },
  };

  const statusCode = results.status === 'unhealthy' ? 503 : 200;
  
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(results, null, 2), {
    status: statusCode,
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Cache-Control': 'no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate',
      'X-Health-Status': results.status,
    },
  });
};

async function checkDatabase(env: Env): Promise<ComponentHealth> {
  const start = Date.now();
  try {
    await env.DB.$queryRaw`SELECT 1`;
    return {
      status: 'healthy',
      latencyMs: Date.now() - start,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      status: 'unhealthy',
      latencyMs: Date.now() - start,
      message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
    };
  }
}
```

### 17.5.2 Health Check Endpoints

| Endpoint | Purpose | Auth Required | Cache |
|----------|---------|:-------------:|-------|
| `GET /api/health` | Full health check | No | no-cache |
| `GET /api/health/live` | Liveness probe | No | no-cache |
| `GET /api/health/ready` | Readiness probe | No | no-cache |
| `GET /api/health/startup` | Startup probe | No | no-cache |
| `GET /api/health/deep` | Deep health check | Admin | no-cache |

### 17.5.3 Health Check Configuration

```typescript
// Liveness: Is the process running?
// GET /api/health/live
// Returns: { status: "alive" }
// Use: Kubernetes/Docker liveness probe, Cloudflare Pages health

// Readiness: Can the process accept traffic?
// GET /api/health/ready
// Checks: Database connectivity, environment variables loaded
// Returns: { status: "ready", checks: { database: "ok", config: "ok" } }
// Use: Traffic routing, load balancer health check

// Startup: Has the process finished starting?
// GET /api/health/startup
// Checks: All services initialized, migrations complete
// Returns: { status: "started", bootTime: "2.3s" }
// Use: Startup probe for slow-starting services

// Deep: Comprehensive health check
// GET /api/health/deep
// Checks: All services, external dependencies, disk, memory
// Returns: Full diagnostic information
// Use: Manual debugging, monitoring systems
```

### 17.5.5 Deployment Health Verification

```yaml
# Post-deployment health check workflow
Post-Deploy Health Check:
  1. Wait 30s for propagation
  2. GET /api/health - Verify 200 OK
  3. GET /api/health/live - Verify alive
  4. GET /api/health/ready - Verify ready
  5. Smoke test critical paths:
     - Homepage loads
     - Product listing works
     - Search returns results
     - Login flow works
     - API responds correctly
  6. Monitor for 15 minutes:
     - Error rate < 1%
     - Latency within SLO
     - No new error types
  7. If health check fails:
     - Immediate rollback
     - Notify team
     - Create incident ticket
```

## 17.6 Security Monitoring

### 17.6.1 Security Event Categories

| Category | Events | Severity | Response |
|----------|--------|----------|----------|
| **Authentication** | Failed logins, lockouts, token abuse | Medium-High | Log + Alert |
| **Authorization** | Permission violations, role escalation | High | Log + Alert + Block |
| **Input Validation** | XSS, SQL injection, path traversal | Critical | Log + Block + Alert |
| **Rate Limiting** | API abuse, DDoS patterns | Medium | Log + Throttle |
| **Data Exposure** | Sensitive data access, unusual queries | High | Log + Alert + Investigate |
| **Admin Activity** | Config changes, user modifications, deletes | Medium | Log + Audit trail |
| **Payment** | Fraud patterns, chargeback attempts | Critical | Log + Alert + Freeze |
| **Upload** | Suspicious files, quota abuse | Medium | Log + Block |
| **Session** | Hijacking attempts, concurrent sessions | High | Log + Invalidate + Alert |

### 17.6.2 Security Monitoring Rules

```typescript
// Security monitoring configuration
const SECURITY_RULES = {
  // Brute force detection
  bruteForce: {
    window: 15 * 60 * 1000, // 15 minutes
    maxAttempts: 5,
    lockoutDuration: 30 * 60 * 1000, // 30 minutes
    action: 'lockout + alert',
  },
  
  // Rate limiting per endpoint
  rateLimits: {
    '/api/auth/login': { window: 60000, max: 5 },
    '/api/auth/register': { window: 3600000, max: 3 },
    '/api/auth/reset-password': { window: 3600000, max: 3 },
    '/api/products': { window: 60000, max: 100 },
    '/api/orders': { window: 60000, max: 30 },
    '/api/search': { window: 60000, max: 60 },
    '/api/upload': { window: 60000, max: 20 },
    '/api/admin/*': { window: 60000, max: 60 },
    '/api/seller/*': { window: 60000, max: 60 },
    'global': { window: 60000, max: 200 },
  },
  
  // Suspicious patterns
  suspiciousPatterns: {
    sqlInjection: /(\b(SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|DROP|UNION|ALTER)\b.*\b(FROM|INTO|WHERE|TABLE)\b)/i,
    xss: /<script[^>]*>|javascript:|on\w+\s*=|eval\(|document\./i,
    pathTraversal: /\.\.[\/\\]|\.\.[\/\\]|\.\.%2f|\.\.%5c/i,
    commandInjection: /[;&|`$()]|(\$\{)/,
  },
  
  // Alert thresholds
  alerts: {
    failedLoginsPerIP: { threshold: 10, window: 3600000 },
    failedLoginsPerUser: { threshold: 5, window: 900000 },
    apiErrorsPerEndpoint: { threshold: 50, window: 300000 },
    rateLimitHitsPerIP: { threshold: 20, window: 300000 },
    suspiciousUploadsPerUser: { threshold: 3, window: 3600000 },
  },
};
```

## 17.7 Backup Strategy

### 17.7.1 Database Backup

| Backup Type | Frequency | Retention | Method | Storage |
|-------------|-----------|-----------|--------|---------|
| Automated Full | Daily | 30 days | Neon automated | Neon storage |
| Point-in-time Recovery | Continuous | 7 days | Neon WAL archiving | Neon storage |
| Manual Export | Weekly | 90 days | pg_dump | Encrypted cloud storage |
| Schema-only | On schema change | Indefinite | Prisma generate | Git repository |
| Pre-deployment | On deploy | 7 days | pg_dump | Encrypted cloud storage |

```bash
# Database backup commands
# Automated daily backup (run via cron/Cloudflare Cron Trigger)
npx prisma db push --schema=./prisma/schema.prisma

# Manual export
pg_dump $DATABASE_URL --format=custom --compress=9 > backup_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).dump

# Schema backup
npx prisma generate
cp prisma/schema.prisma backups/schema_$(date +%Y%m%d).prisma

# Restore from backup
pg_restore -d $DATABASE_URL backup_20260714_120000.dump
```

### 17.7.2 Media Backup

| Asset Type | Backup Method | Frequency | Retention |
|------------|---------------|-----------|-----------|
| Product Images | Cloudinary API | Daily | 30 days |

| Category Images | Cloudinary API | Daily | 30 days |
| Banner Images | Cloudinary API | On change | 30 days |

```typescript
// Cloudinary backup script
async function backupCloudinaryMedia() {
  const resources = await cloudinary.api.resources({
    type: 'upload',
    max_results: 500,
    resource_type: 'image',
  });
  
  for (const resource of resources.resources) {
    await downloadAndStore(
      resource.secure_url,
      `backups/media/${resource.public_id}.${resource.format}`
    );
  }
}
```

### 17.7.5 Disaster Recovery

**Recovery Time Objective (RTO):** 4 hours
**Recovery Point Objective (RPO):** 1 hour (automated), 24 hours (manual)

```yaml
Disaster Recovery Plan:
  Scenario 1 - Database Corruption:
    Detection: Health check failures, error spikes
    Response:
      1. Stop all writes immediately
      2. Assess extent of corruption
      3. Restore from latest point-in-time recovery
      4. Replay WAL segments to minimize data loss
      5. Validate data integrity
      6. Resume operations
    RTO: 2 hours
    RPO: 1 hour

  Scenario 2 - Complete Data Loss:
    Detection: Database unreachable, all queries failing
    Response:
      1. Activate read-only mode
      2. Contact Neon support
      3. Restore from automated backup
      4. If automated backup unavailable, restore from manual export
      5. Reconcile with payment records
      6. Resume operations
    RTO: 4 hours
    RPO: 24 hours

  Scenario 3 - Cloudinary Failure:
    Detection: Image load errors, upload failures
    Response:
      1. Enable placeholder images
      2. Disable new uploads
      3. Contact Cloudinary support
      4. If extended outage, switch to backup CDN
      5. Re-sync media when恢复
    RTO: 1 hour
    RPO: 0 (media immutable)

  Scenario 4 - Cloudflare Outage:
    Detection: DNS resolution failures, edge errors
    Response:
      1. Monitor Cloudflare status page
      2. If extended, enable maintenance mode
      3. Communicate with users
      4. Resume when Cloudflare recovers
    RTO: Cloudflare-dependent
    RPO: 0
```

### 17.7.6 Restore Testing

| Test | Frequency | Procedure | Success Criteria |
|------|-----------|-----------|-----------------|
| Database Restore | Monthly | Restore backup to staging | Data integrity verified |
| Media Restore | Monthly | Download and re-upload sample | Images accessible |
| Config Restore | Quarterly | Apply config to fresh environment | Application starts correctly |
| Full DR Drill | Semi-annually | Complete system restore | All services operational |
| Backup Integrity | Weekly | Verify backup checksums | All backups valid |

## 17.8 Incident Response

### 17.8.1 Incident Severity Levels

| Level | Name | Description | Response Time | Escalation |
|-------|------|-------------|:-------------:|------------|
| **SEV-1** | Critical | Complete system outage or data breach | 15 minutes | Immediate |
| **SEV-2** | Major | Core functionality broken (payments, auth) | 30 minutes | 1 hour |
| **SEV-3** | Minor | Non-critical feature broken | 4 hours | 24 hours |
| **SEV-4** | Low | Cosmetic issue or minor inconvenience | 24 hours | 1 week |

### 17.8.2 Incident Response Procedures

#### SEV-1: Critical Outage

```
IMMEDIATE ACTIONS (0-15 minutes):
├── 1. Acknowledge alert in PagerDuty/Slack
├── 2. Join incident response channel (#incidents)
├── 3. Post initial assessment:
│   ├── What is affected?
│   ├── When did it start?
│   ├── What is the impact?
│   └── Who is on the incident call?
├── 4. Begin investigation:
│   ├── Check Cloudflare status
│   ├── Check Neon status
│   ├── Check Supabase status
│   ├── Check Razorpay status
│   ├── Check Cloudinary status
│   └── Check application logs
└── 5. Declare incident if confirmed

SHORT-TERM ACTIONS (15-60 minutes):
├── 6. Implement temporary fix or workaround
├── 7. If fix not possible:
│   ├── Initiate rollback if deployment-related
│   ├── Enable maintenance mode if needed
│   └── Communicate status to stakeholders
├── 8. Monitor for improvement
└── 9. Update incident channel with progress

RESOLUTION (1-4 hours):
├── 10. Implement permanent fix
├── 11. Verify fix in production
├── 12. Monitor for 30 minutes
├── 13. Close incident
└── 14. Schedule post-mortem

POST-MORTEM (within 48 hours):
├── 15. Document timeline
├── 16. Identify root cause
├── 17. Document impact
├── 18. List action items
├── 19. Assign owners and deadlines
└── 20. Share with team
```

#### SEV-2: Major Functionality Broken

```
RESPONSE PROCEDURE:
├── 1. Acknowledge alert (30 min SLA)
├── 2. Investigate and diagnose
├── 3. If fix available:
│   ├── Implement fix
│   ├── Test in production
│   └── Monitor
├── 4. If fix not available:
│   ├── Implement workaround
│   ├── Communicate to users
│   └── Escalate if needed
└── 5. Post-incident review
```

### 17.8.3 Specific Incident Playbooks

#### Database Failure

```
PLAYBOOK: Database Failure
─────────────────────────
1. Confirm database is unreachable
2. Check Neon status page
3. Check connection pool exhaustion
4. If connection pool:
   ├── Kill idle connections
   ├── Restart connection pooler
   └── Monitor recovery
5. If database down:
   ├── Contact Neon support
   ├── Enable read-only mode (if possible)
   ├── Switch to cached data
   └── Communicate to users
6. If data corruption:
   ├── Stop all writes
   ├── Assess damage
   ├── Restore from backup
   └── Validate data integrity
```

#### Payment Failure

```
PLAYBOOK: Payment Failure
─────────────────────────
1. Check Razorpay status page
2. Check webhook delivery status
3. If Razorpay down:
   ├── Enable manual payment collection
   ├── Communicate to users
   └── Monitor for recovery
4. If webhook failure:
   ├── Check webhook logs
   ├── Verify endpoint accessibility
   ├── Retry failed webhooks
   └── Manually reconcile if needed
5. If fraud detected:
   ├── Freeze affected account
   ├── Review recent transactions
   ├── Contact affected users
   └── Report to Razorpay
```

#### Cloudinary Failure

```
PLAYBOOK: Cloudinary Failure
────────────────────────────
1. Check Cloudinary status page
2. Check API key validity
3. If Cloudinary down:
   ├── Enable placeholder images
   ├── Disable new uploads
   ├── Serve cached images
   └── Communicate to users
4. If API key invalid:
   ├── Generate new API key
   ├── Update environment variables
   ├── Redeploy if needed
   └── Verify image delivery
5. If quota exceeded:
   ├── Upgrade plan
   ├── Clean unused assets
   └── Optimize transformations
```

#### Security Incident

```
PLAYBOOK: Security Incident
───────────────────────────
1. IMMEDIATELY:
   ├── Contain the breach
   ├── Preserve evidence
   ├── Notify security lead
   └── Begin documentation
2. ASSESSMENT:
   ├── What data was accessed?
   ├── How many users affected?
   ├── Is attack ongoing?
   └── What vulnerabilities were exploited?
3. RESPONSE:
   ├── Rotate all compromised credentials
   ├── Invalidate affected sessions
   ├── Block attacking IPs
   ├── Notify affected users (if required)
   └── Report to authorities (if required)
4. RECOVERY:
   ├── Patch vulnerabilities
   ├── Restore from clean backups
   ├── Verify system integrity
   └── Monitor for recurrence
5. POST-INCIDENT:
   ├── Complete incident report
   ├── Conduct security review
   ├── Implement additional controls
   └── Update security procedures
```

### 17.10.2 Cost Optimization Strategies

| Strategy | Implementation | Savings |
|----------|---------------|:-------:|
| **Image Optimization** | Cloudinary auto-format, quality | 30-50% bandwidth |
| **Caching** | Aggressive caching, stale-while-revalidate | 40-60% origin load |
| **Query Optimization** | N+1 elimination, indexing | 50-70% DB load |
| **API Response Compression** | gzip/brotli compression | 60-80% transfer size |
| **Lazy Loading** | Code splitting, dynamic imports | 30-50% initial load |
| **CDN Cache Warming** | Pre-cache popular pages | 20-30% miss rate |
| **Connection Pooling** | PgBouncer, connection reuse | 40-60% connection overhead |
| **Rate Limiting** | Prevent abuse, reduce load | Variable |

## 17.12 Change Management

### 17.12.1 Deployment Workflow

```
Development Workflow:
─────────────────────
1. Create feature branch from main
2. Implement changes
3. Write/update tests
4. Run local verification:
   ├── npm run typecheck
   ├── npm run lint
   ├── npm run test
   └── npm run build
5. Create pull request
6. Code review (required)
7. Merge to main after approval
8. Automated deployment to staging
9. Staging verification
10. Production deployment (manual trigger)

Deployment Pipeline:
────────────────────
┌─────────┐   ┌─────────┐   ┌─────────┐   ┌─────────┐
│  Dev    │──▶│ Staging │──▶│ Prod    │──▶│ Monitor │
│  (auto) │   │ (auto)  │   │ (manual)│   │ (auto)  │
└─────────┘   └─────────┘   └─────────┘   └─────────┘
     │              │              │              │
     ▼              ▼              ▼              ▼
  Build &       Smoke Test    Health Check   Alert if
  Deploy        Full Test     Verify         Issues
```

### 17.12.2 Rollback Procedure

```yaml
Rollback Procedure:
  Trigger:
    - Health check failure after deployment
    - Error rate spike > 5%
    - Critical functionality broken
    - Security vulnerability discovered
  
  Steps:
    1. Identify last known good deployment
    2. Initiate rollback via Cloudflare dashboard or API
    3. Verify rollback successful:
       - Health check returns 200
       - Error rate returns to baseline
       - Critical paths working
    4. Notify team of rollback
    5. Investigate root cause
    6. Fix issue in development
    7. Redeploy through normal process
  
  Time to Complete: < 5 minutes
  Data Impact: None (code-only rollback)
  User Impact: Brief interruption during rollback
```

### 17.12.3 Hotfix Process

```
Hotfix Procedure:
─────────────────
1. Create hotfix branch from main
2. Implement minimal fix
3. Write focused tests
4. Run verification:
   ├── typecheck
   ├── lint
   ├── test
   └── build
5. Create emergency PR
6. Get expedited review (1 approver minimum)
7. Merge to main
8. Deploy immediately
9. Monitor for 15 minutes
10. If stable, close hotfix
11. If issues, rollback and reassess
```

### 17.12.4 Emergency Patch

```
Emergency Patch Procedure:
──────────────────────────
1. When hotfix not possible via normal flow
2. Direct push to main (requires 2 approvals)
3. Immediate deployment
4. Enhanced monitoring
5. Full review within 24 hours
6. Document exception
```

### 17.12.5 Change Approval Matrix

| Change Type | Approval Required | Testing Required | Deployment |
|-------------|:-----------------:|:----------------:|:----------:|
| Feature | 2 code reviews | Full test suite | Staging → Prod |
| Bug Fix | 1 code review | Relevant tests | Staging → Prod |
| Hotfix | 1 code review | Focused tests | Direct to Prod |
| Config Change | 1 approval | Smoke test | Direct to Prod |
| Database Schema | 2 approvals | Migration test | Staging → Prod |
| Security Fix | 2 approvals | Security scan | Staging → Prod |
| Emergency | 2 approvals | Minimal | Direct to Prod |

## 17.13 Version Management

### 17.13.1 Semantic Versioning

```
Version Format: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH

Examples:
  1.0.0 - Initial production release
  1.0.1 - Bug fix
  1.1.0 - New feature (backward compatible)
  1.1.1 - Bug fix for feature
  2.0.0 - Breaking change
  2.0.1 - Bug fix for breaking change
  2.1.0 - New feature with breaking change

Pre-release versions:
  1.0.0-beta.1 - Beta release
  1.0.0-rc.1 - Release candidate
  1.0.0-alpha.1 - Alpha release
```

### 17.13.2 Release Notes Format

```markdown
# Release v1.1.0

## Date
2026-07-14

## Changes

### Added
- New feature X
- New feature Y

### Changed
- Improved performance of Z
- Updated dependency A

### Fixed
- Bug in feature B
- Issue with component C

### Removed
- Deprecated feature D

### Security
- Patched vulnerability in E

## Migration Notes
- No breaking changes
- No migration required

## Known Issues
- None

## Contributors
- @developer1
- @developer2
```

### 17.13.3 Breaking Changes Policy

| Change Type | Version Bump | Migration Guide | Deprecation Notice |
|-------------|:------------:|:---------------:|:------------------:|
| API endpoint removal | Major | Required | 2 versions prior |
| Database schema change | Major | Required | 2 versions prior |
| Authentication change | Major | Required | 2 versions prior |
| UI component API change | Minor | Recommended | 1 version prior |
| Configuration change | Minor | Required | Current version |
| Dependency upgrade (major) | Minor | If breaking | 1 version prior |

### 17.13.4 Deprecation Policy

```
Deprecation Timeline:
──────────────────────
Version N: Feature deprecated, warning shown
Version N+1: Feature still available, stronger warning
Version N+2: Feature removed

Example:
  v1.0.0: /api/old-endpoint deprecated
  v1.1.0: /api/old-endpoint shows warning
  v2.0.0: /api/old-endpoint removed

Migration Support:
  - Documentation updated
  - Migration guide provided
  - Automated migration script (if possible)
  - Support channel for questions
```

### 17.13.5 Changelog Management

| Section | Content | Example |
|---------|---------|---------|
| Added | New features | "Added product search autocomplete" |
| Changed | Changes to existing features | "Improved image loading performance" |
| Deprecated | Features being removed | "Deprecated legacy checkout flow" |
| Removed | Removed features | "Removed v1 API endpoints" |
| Fixed | Bug fixes | "Fixed cart quantity calculation" |
| Security | Security fixes | "Patched XSS vulnerability" |

## Architecture Status

### System Architecture Assessment: 7.0/10 (B-)

| Component | Score | Status | Notes |
|-----------|:-----:|:------:|-------|
| Frontend (React 19.1.0) | 7/10 | ✅ Solid | Functional components, hooks, lazy loading |
| Routing (React Router 7.5.0) | 7/10 | ✅ Solid | Nested routes, protected routes, lazy loading |
| Styling (Tailwind CSS 3.4.17) | 8/10 | ✅ Strong | Custom design system, 183-line config |
| State (Zustand + TanStack Query) | 7/10 | ✅ Solid | Proper server/client state separation |
| Build (Vite 6.3.2) | 7/10 | ✅ Solid | Fast builds, admin chunk filtering |
| Backend (Cloudflare Pages Functions) | 7/10 | ✅ Solid | Edge compute, 245+ endpoints |
| Database (PostgreSQL via Neon) | 8/10 | ✅ Strong | 61 models, 150+ indexes, GIN trigrams |
| ORM (Prisma 6.6.0) | 8/10 | ✅ Strong | Type-safe, parameterized queries |
| Auth (Supabase Auth) | 7/10 | ✅ Solid | JWT httpOnly cookies, session management |
| Payments (Razorpay) | 7/10 | ✅ Solid | UPI, cards, webhooks, signature verification |
| Email (Resend) | 7/10 | ✅ Solid | Transactional emails, verification |
| Media CDN (Cloudinary) | 8/10 | ✅ Strong | Auto format/quality, responsive srcset |
| Hosting (Cloudflare Pages) | 7/10 | ✅ Solid | Global CDN, edge functions, smart placement |

### Architecture Strengths
- Single backend entry point via `api/[...path].ts` catch-all router
- Prisma as single source of truth for all database access
- Zero raw SQL in application code (2 instances in soft-delete utility only)
- Proper separation of concerns (handlers, middleware, services)
- Edge-first architecture with Cloudflare Workers
- Comprehensive API with 245+ endpoints across 62 handler modules

### Architecture Concerns
- Hyperdrive configured but not actively used (connection pooling disabled)
- Logger uses in-memory storage (lost on cold starts)
- No server-side caching for product/catalog queries
- Sentry monitoring entirely disabled (no-ops)
- Rate limiting falls open on KV miss

## Code Quality

### Code Quality Assessment: 5.5/10 (C+)

| Metric | Value | Target | Status |
|--------|:-----:|:------:|:------:|
| TypeScript strict mode | Enabled | Enabled | ✅ |
| `any` type annotations | 579 | 0 | ❌ |
| `as never` assertions | 96+ | 0 | ❌ |
| `console.log` statements | 139 | 0 | ❌ |
| Empty catch blocks | 167 | 0 | ❌ |
| ESLint `no-explicit-any` | Off | Error | ❌ |
| ESLint `no-unused-vars` | Off | Error | ❌ |
| ESLint `exhaustive-deps` | Off | Error | ❌ |
| ESLint `no-floating-promises` | Off | Error | ❌ |
| React.memo usage | 0 components | All performance-critical | ❌ |
| Unused imports/variables | 30+ instances | 0 | ❌ |
| Duplicate constant definitions | 6+ sets | 0 | ❌ |

### Critical Code Quality Findings

#### Type Safety (HIGH)
- **579 `any` type annotations** across the codebase, predominantly in API handlers (`env: any` pattern in every handler)
- **96+ `as never` type assertions** bypassing TypeScript's type system
- **Impact:** Runtime type errors that TypeScript should catch at compile time
- **Location:** Worst offenders: `src/admin/cms/HomepageBuilder.tsx` (26+ casts), `api/_handlers/` (every file)

#### Dead Code (MEDIUM)
- **30+ unused variables** with `_` prefix convention indicating intentional suppression
- `_videoReady` state in HeroCarousel set but never read
- `_initialized` and `_collapsed` state in ProductFormPage never used
- `_clearOfflineQueue`, `_setSyncError`, `_total` state setters never invoked
- **Impact:** Increased bundle size, cognitive load, and unnecessary re-renders

#### Console Statements (MEDIUM)
- **139 `console.log`/`console.error`/`console.warn` statements** in production code
- 73 in `src/` frontend code (media services, performance monitor, main entry)
- 66 in `api/` backend code (auth, media handlers)
- **Impact:** Information leakage, performance overhead, unprofessional output

#### Empty Catch Blocks (MEDIUM)
- **167 empty `catch {}` blocks** silently swallowing errors
- Critical locations: `useCartSync.ts` (4 blocks), `OrderDetailPage.tsx` (3 blocks), `CustomersPage.tsx` (2 blocks)
- **Impact:** Hidden failures, impossible debugging, masked bugs

#### Memory Leaks (HIGH)
- `src/lib/media/security.service.ts`: Global `setInterval` at module load with no cleanup reference
- `src/lib/serviceWorker.ts`: Connectivity detection intervals not guaranteed to be cleaned up
- `src/hooks/useInfiniteScroll.ts`: Stale closure bug with empty dependency array
- Multiple `useEffect` hooks without AbortController for fetch calls
- **Impact:** Memory accumulation, stale state, potential crashes

#### Direct DOM Manipulation (MEDIUM)
- `document.body.style.overflow` in 6 files (18 occurrences) — no coordination between overlapping modals
- `document.title` in 4 files — bypasses react-helmet-async integration
- `window.location.href` and `window.location.reload()` in 20+ files — breaks SPA experience
- **Impact:** React state desynchronization, poor UX, flash of unstyled content

#### Duplicate Constants (MEDIUM)
- `SITE_NAME`: 3 different definitions with different values ("নবME" vs "নবME — Premium Fashion")
- `ALLOWED_IMAGE_TYPES`: 3 separate definitions
- `UPLOAD_MAX_SIZE`: 3 different values (5MB, 10MB, 20MB)
- `FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD`: 2 definitions
- **Impact:** Inconsistent behavior, maintenance burden, potential bugs

### ESLint Configuration Issues (MEDIUM)

| Rule | Current | Recommended | Impact |
|------|:-------:|:-----------:|--------|
| `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` | Off | Error | 579 `any` types |
| `@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars` | Off | Error | 30+ unused variables |
| `@typescript-eslint/no-floating-promises` | Off | Error | Unhandled rejections |
| `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` | Off | Error | Stale closures, memory leaks |
| `no-console` | Off | Error | 139 console statements |

## Security Status

### Security Assessment: 6.5/10 (D+)

| Component | Score | Status | Notes |
|-----------|:-----:|:------:|-------|
| Authentication | 7/10 | ✅ Solid | JWT httpOnly cookies, session rotation |
| Authorization | 7/10 | ✅ Solid | Role-based (customer/admin), admin guards |
| CSRF Protection | 7/10 | ✅ Solid | Double-submit cookie pattern enforced |
| Input Validation | 2/10 | ❌ Weak | Zod schemas exist but only 5% adoption |
| Secrets Management | 5/10 | ⚠️ Risk | `.env` in git history, `.gitignore` active |
| Error Monitoring | 1/10 | ❌ Critical | Sentry entirely disabled (no-ops) |
| SQL Injection | 8/10 | ✅ Strong | Prisma ORM, 2 unsafe raw queries in utility |
| Rate Limiting | 6/10 | ⚠️ Partial | Works but falls open on KV miss |
| Security Headers | 8/10 | ✅ Strong | CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options all present |
| CORS | 7/10 | ✅ Solid | Properly configured with credentials |
| XSS Prevention | 8/10 | ✅ Strong | Server-side HTML sanitization, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML misuse |
| Password Security | 8/10 | ✅ Strong | Brute force protection, lockout after 5 attempts |
| Webhook Security | 8/10 | ✅ Strong | HMAC-SHA256 timing-safe verification |
| Bot Protection | 6/10 | ⚠️ Graceful | Turnstile implemented, degrades when key missing |

### Security Strengths
- **httpOnly cookies** for all auth tokens (access + refresh + CSRF)
- **Session rotation** with revocation tracking
- **CSRF double-submit** cookie pattern with X-CSRF-Token header
- **Zero `eval()`/`Function()`** usage in entire codebase
- **Server-side HTML sanitization** blocks `<script>`, `<iframe>`, event handlers
- **Brute force protection** — account lockout after 5 failed attempts, IP blocking
- **Webhook signature verification** with timing-safe comparison
- **Token hashing** (SHA-256) before database storage
- **Ownership validation** on payment operations

### Security Concerns (Residual)

| Issue | Severity | Status | Mitigation |
|-------|:--------:|:------:|------------|
| `.env` secrets in git history | Critical | ⚠️ | `.gitignore` active; requires git history purge + credential rotation |
| Sentry disabled | High | ❌ | All monitoring functions are no-ops |
| 95% endpoints without input validation | High | ❌ | Zod exists but only 5% adopted |
| Rate limiting falls open on KV miss | Medium | ⚠️ | Returns null, allows unlimited requests |
| Turnstile graceful degradation | Medium | ⚠️ | Returns null when key missing |
| KV namespace ID collision | High | ❌ | `RATE_LIMIT_STORE` and `CACHE` share same ID |
| 139 console statements leak info | Medium | ⚠️ | Internal details exposed in production |

### Positive Security Findings

| Finding | Evidence |
|---------|----------|
| Zero hardcoded secrets in source code | All secrets in `.env` only |
| Auth tokens never in localStorage | httpOnly cookies throughout |
| All database queries parameterized | Prisma ORM, zero raw SQL in app |
| Proper CORS configuration | Credentials allowed, specific origins |
| Security headers complete | CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, Permissions-Policy |
| Email verification with lockout | 6-digit code, 24h expiry, lockout protection |
| Payment ownership validation | Order ownership verified before processing |
| Session device tracking | IP, user agent, device name logged |

## Performance Status

### Performance Assessment: 5.0/10 (D)

| Metric | Current | Target | Status |
|--------|:-------:|:------:|:------:|
| TTFB (cold start) | 13.6s | <2s | ❌ Critical |
| TTFB (warm) | ~200ms | <500ms | ✅ |
| Main JS Bundle | 322KB | <250KB | ⚠️ |
| CSS Bundle | 114KB | <100KB | ⚠️ |
| Lighthouse Performance | Unknown | ≥70 | ❌ Not enforced |
| Lighthouse Accessibility | Unknown | ≥80 | ❌ Not enforced |
| Route Splitting | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Image Optimization | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ Cloudinary auto format/quality |
| CSS Minification | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ LightningCSS |
| JS Minification | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ esbuild |
| Service Worker | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ Cache strategies |
| Brotli Compression | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ Cloudflare |

### Performance Strengths
- **Route-based code splitting** — all pages lazy-loaded via React.lazy()
- **Cloudinary image optimization** — auto format (f_auto), auto quality (q_auto), responsive srcset
- **CSS optimization** — LightningCSS minification
- **JS optimization** — esbuild minification, Rollup-determined chunking
- **Cloudflare CDN** — global edge caching, Brotli compression
- **Smart Placement** — Cloudflare Workers positioned near database

### Performance Concerns

| Issue | Severity | Impact | Root Cause |
|-------|:--------:|:------:|------------|
| 13.6s cold start TTFB | Critical | All first visitors | Hyperdrive disabled, Neon connection overhead |
| Hyperdrive not active | High | Connection pooling | Causing 530 errors on Prisma queries |
| No server-side caching | High | Repeated DB queries | Product/catalog queries hit DB every time |
| 579 `any` types | Medium | Bundle bloat | TypeScript cannot optimize as well |
| 139 console statements | Low | Minor overhead | Production logging overhead |
| 0 React.memo components | Medium | Unnecessary rerenders | All children re-render on parent state change |
| No bundle analysis tooling | Medium | No regression detection | Bundle size could grow unchecked |
| In-memory logger | Medium | Lost on cold starts | No persistent logging service |

### Performance Recommendations (No New Features)
1. **Enable Hyperdrive** for connection pooling (reduces cold start)
2. **Add React.memo** to ProductCard, SafeImage, Footer, and admin list components
3. **Replace `window.location.reload()`** with React Query refetch in 15+ files
4. **Add AbortController** to useEffect fetch calls to prevent wasted work
5. **Consolidate duplicate constants** to reduce bundle size

### Schema Quality
- **61 models** with proper relations and cascade rules
- **150+ indexes** including composite indexes for common query patterns
- **GIN trigram indexes** for fuzzy search (`pg_trgm` extension)
- **UUID primary keys** throughout (no sequential ID leakage)
- **Soft delete pattern** consistently applied via `isActive` boolean
- **Proper cascade rules** on all foreign keys

### Index Analysis

#### Well-Indexed Tables
| Table | Indexes | Notes |
|-------|:-------:|-------|
| products | 8 | Composite on `[isActive, categoryId, sortOrder]`, `[isActive, basePrice]`, `[isActive, gender, createdAt]` |
| orders | 6 | Composite on `[status, createdAt]`, `[profileId, status, createdAt]` |
| profiles | 3 | `[role]`, `[isActive]`, `[createdAt]` |
| auth_sessions | 4 | `[profileId, isActive]`, `[expiresAt]`, `[refreshTokenExpiresAt]`, `[rotatedFromSessionId]` |
| product_variants | 2 | `[productId, size, color]` unique |

#### Missing Indexes (Low Priority)
| Table | Field | Impact |
|-------|-------|--------|
| reviews | orderId | Order-to-review lookups |
| support_tickets | createdAt | Date sorting |
| search_history | query | Text search |
| analytics_events | pageUrl | Page analytics |
| api_keys | key | Should be `@unique` |

#### Redundant Indexes
| Table | Redundant | Covered By |
|-------|-----------|------------|
| products | `isActive, basePrice` | `isActive, basePrice, sortOrder` |
| products | `categoryId` (single) | `isActive, categoryId, sortOrder` |

### Database Concerns
- **N+1 query pattern** in `api/_handlers/admin/media.ts` — 13 sequential queries with 3 N+1 loops
- **Hyperdrive not active** — connection pooling disabled, causing 13.6s cold starts
- **`api_keys.key` missing `@unique`** — duplicate API keys theoretically possible
- **Missing GIN index** for full-text search on product name/description

## Remaining Risks

### Critical Risks (Must Address Before Scale)

| # | Risk | Impact | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|---|------|:------:|:----------:|------------|
| 1 | Secrets in git history | Full system compromise | Medium | Rotate all credentials, purge git history |
| 2 | Sentry disabled | Zero error visibility | High | Enable Sentry integration |
| 3 | 13.6s cold start TTFB | First visitor timeout | High | Enable Hyperdrive, add edge caching |
| 4 | 579 `any` types | Runtime type errors | High | Incrementally add proper types |
| 5 | KV namespace ID collision | Rate limit/cache corruption | High | Create separate KV namespace for CACHE |

### High Risks (Address Before Growth)

| # | Risk | Impact | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|---|------|:------:|:----------:|------------|
| 6 | No server-side caching | DB overload at scale | Medium | Add KV/Cache API caching |
| 7 | N+1 query patterns | Slow admin pages | Medium | Optimize with includes/joins |
| 8 | 167 empty catch blocks | Hidden failures | Medium | Add structured logging |
| 9 | No webhook idempotency | Double processing | Medium | Add idempotency keys |
| 10 | Incomplete test coverage | Regression risk | Medium | Add tests for checkout, payments, orders |

### Medium Risks (Address During Growth)

| # | Risk | Impact | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|---|------|:------:|:----------:|------------|
| 11 | ESLint rules disabled | Code quality drift | High | Enable rules incrementally |
| 12 | No React.memo | Performance degradation | Medium | Add memoization to key components |
| 13 | Direct DOM manipulation | React state desync | Medium | Replace with React patterns |
| 14 | Duplicate constants | Inconsistent behavior | Low | Consolidate to single source |
| 15 | 139 console statements | Info leakage | Low | Replace with structured logger |

### Certification Blockers

| # | Blocker | Severity | Category | Est. Fix |
|---|---------|:--------:|:--------:|:--------:|
| 1 | Secrets in git history (`.env` with production keys) | Critical | Security | 2h + credential rotation |
| 2 | Sentry monitoring entirely disabled | Critical | Observability | 4h |
| 3 | 13.6s TTFB on cold starts | Critical | Performance | 8h (enable Hyperdrive) |
| 4 | KV namespace ID collision (RATE_LIMIT_STORE = CACHE) | High | Infrastructure | 1h |
| 5 | 579 `any` type annotations bypassing type safety | High | Code Quality | 40h |
| 6 | No input validation on 95% of endpoints | High | Security | 40h |
| 7 | 167 empty catch blocks hiding errors | Medium | Reliability | 8h |
| 8 | 139 console.log statements in production | Medium | Security | 4h |
| 9 | No React.memo on any component | Medium | Performance | 8h |
| 10 | Missing tests for checkout, payments, orders | Medium | Testing | 20h |

### If Certification Passes (After Blocker Remediation)

The project would be considered **production-ready** with the following conditions:
1. All P0 blockers remediated
2. All credentials rotated
3. Sentry enabled and capturing errors
4. Hyperdrive activated for connection pooling
5. Input validation added to critical endpoints
6. Test coverage for checkout/payments/orders

### Current Status

**NABOME is a functional, live e-commerce platform** with:
- 245+ API endpoints
- 72 pages
- 157+ components
- 61 database models
- Full checkout flow with Razorpay payments
- Admin dashboard with 44 modules
- Media library with Cloudinary integration
- Authentication with session management
- Comprehensive documentation (30,957 lines)

**The platform is operational** but requires immediate attention to the 10 certification blockers listed above before it can be certified for enterprise-grade production use at scale.
